    _require(captured["relationship"] == "external_project"
             and captured["source_project_id"] != workspace.project["id"]
             and captured["native"] is None,
             "Open the original saved comparison for a source already local to this project")
    _require(captured["source_body_sha256"] == checksum,
             "Reopen the exact received source before creating its local comparison")
    title = payload.get("title")
    if title is None:
        title = ("Local copy: " + captured["title"])[:200]
    _require(isinstance(title, str) and title.strip() and len(title.strip()) <= 200
             and "\0" not in title, "Enter a local comparison title of at most 200 characters")
    title = title.strip()
    collection = workspace._get("sources", collection_id)
    entries = [row for row in collection["entries"] if row["id"] == source_id]
    _require(len(entries) == 1 and entries[0]["body"]["sha256"] == checksum,
             "Received source collection differs from its captured report")
    entry = entries[0]
    members = {row.get("view_path", row["filename"]): row for row in entry.get("companions", [])}
    _require(len(members) == len(entry.get("companions", [])),
             "Received source repeats an original companion")
    report_file = members["selection.json"]
    report = read_json(verify_file(workspace.root, {
        "path": report_file["object"], "bytes": report_file["bytes"], "sha256": report_file["sha256"]}))
    _require(report["selection"] == captured["selection"]
             and report["binding"]["analysis_sha256"] == captured["source_binding"]["analysis_sha256"],
             "Received comparison changed its original selection or analysis")
    originals = report["binding"]["inputs"]
    _require(len(originals) == 4, "Retain all four original analysis and annual input records")
    files, seen = [], set()
    for index, item in enumerate(originals):
        original = item["entry"]
        _require(item["source_id"] == original["id"] and original["id"] not in seen
                 and item["source_collection_id"] == report["binding"]["source_collection_id"],
                 "Original analysis input identities differ")
        seen.add(original["id"])
        for body in [original["body"], *original.get("companions", [])]:
            name = "originals/" + str(index) + "/" + _relative(body.get("view_path", body["filename"]))
            actual = members.get(name)
            _require(actual is not None and actual["bytes"] == body["bytes"]
                     and actual["sha256"] == body["sha256"],
                     "The received report lacks an exact original input: " + name)
            path = verify_file(workspace.root, {
                "path": actual["object"], "bytes": body["bytes"], "sha256": body["sha256"]})
            files.append({"path": name, "object": actual["object"],
                          "bytes": body["bytes"], "sha256": body["sha256"]})
    identity = {
        "edition": EDITION, "producer_sha256": file_digest(__file__),
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "study_id": key, "title": title,
        "source": {"source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": source_id},
        "source_body_sha256": checksum, "captured_lineage": deepcopy(captured["lineage"]),
        "original_selection_sha256": report_file["sha256"],
    }
    copy_id = digest(identity)
    if payload.get("copy_id") is not None:
        _require(identifier(payload["copy_id"]) == copy_id,
                 "The local-copy preview changed; verify the received source again")
    return identity, copy_id, report, originals, files

def _manifest(identity, key, originals, created_at):
    entries = []
    for index, item in enumerate(originals):
        original = item["entry"]
        entry = {name: deepcopy(value) for name, value in original.items()
                 if name not in ("body", "companions")}
        metadata = deepcopy(entry.get("metadata") or {})
        lineage = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "copy_id": key, "project_id": identity["project_id"],
            "source_project_id": identity["captured_lineage"]["source_project_id"],
            "original_source": deepcopy(identity["source"]),
            "original_source_body_sha256": identity["source_body_sha256"],
            "original_selection_id": identity["captured_lineage"]["observed_landcover_selection_id"],
            "original_input_collection_id": item["source_collection_id"],
            "original_input_source_id": item["source_id"],
            "original_input_entry_sha256": digest(original),
        }
        if ORIGIN_KEY in metadata:
            lineage["previous"] = metadata[ORIGIN_KEY]
        metadata[ORIGIN_KEY] = lineage
        entry["metadata"] = metadata
        body = original["body"]
        entry.update(path="originals/" + str(index) + "/" + _relative(
            body.get("view_path", body["filename"])),
            bytes=body["bytes"], sha256=body["sha256"])
        entry["companions"] = [
            {"path": "originals/" + str(index) + "/" + _relative(body.get("view_path", body["filename"])),
             "bytes": body["bytes"], "sha256": body["sha256"]}
            for body in original.get("companions", [])]
        entries.append(entry)
    return {
        "schema": "upstate.sources/v1",
        "title": identity["title"] + " — original received inputs",
        "captured_at": created_at, "entries": entries,
        "scope": {"received_landcover_copy": {"id": key, "identity": deepcopy(identity)}},
        "notes": ["Original publisher metadata and bytes are retained. This source edition admits "
                  "the captured original inputs into the receiving project."],
    }


def _same_science(original, current):

    _require(original["selection"]["huc12s"] == current["selection"]["huc12s"]
             and original["summary"] == current["summary"]

             "Local comparison changed the captured original quantities or selected watersheds")


def create(workspace, payload):
    from . import observed_landcover
    _require(isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get("copy_id") is not None,
             "Verify this source through the local-copy preview first")
    identity, key, report, originals, files = _context(workspace, payload)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    with held(directory / ".copy.lock", blocking=False):
        if (directory / "receipt.json").exists():
            return get(workspace, key)
        plan_path = directory / "source-admission.json"
        previous = read_json(plan_path) if plan_path.exists() else None
        created_at = previous["created_at"] if previous else now()
        plan = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "identity": identity, "created_at": created_at,
                "original_inputs": deepcopy(originals), "files": deepcopy(files)}
        atomic_json(plan_path, plan, immutable=True)
        for row in files:
            copy_verified(workspace.root,
                          {"path": row["object"], "bytes": row["bytes"], "sha256": row["sha256"]},
                          directory, path=row["path"])
        manifest_path = directory / "sources.json"
        atomic_json(manifest_path, _manifest(identity, key, originals, created_at), immutable=True)
        imported = workspace.import_sources(manifest_path)
        selection = {
            "source_collection_id": imported["id"],
            "analysis_source_id": report["binding"]["analysis_source_id"],
            "analysis_sha256": report["binding"]["analysis_sha256"],
            "huc12s": deepcopy(report["selection"]["huc12s"]), "title": identity["title"],
        }
        inputs = observed_landcover.load_inputs(workspace, selection)
        proposed = observed_landcover.summarize(inputs, selection)
        _same_science(report, proposed)
        edition = observed_landcover.build(workspace, selection)
        local = observed_landcover.inspect(workspace, edition["id"])
        _same_science(report, local["report"])
        receipt = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "state": "complete", "identity": identity,
            "created_at": created_at, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
            "title": identity["title"], "original_source": deepcopy(identity["source"]),
            "original_source_body_sha256": identity["source_body_sha256"],
            "source_project_id": identity["captured_lineage"]["source_project_id"],
            "original_selection_id": identity["captured_lineage"]["observed_landcover_selection_id"],
            "local_selection_id": edition["id"], "local_source": deepcopy(edition["source"]),
            "input_collection_id": imported["id"], "selection": deepcopy(local["report"]["selection"]),
            "source_binding": deepcopy(local["report"]["binding"]),
            "summary": deepcopy(local["report"]["summary"]),
            "files": {"source_admission": describe_file(workspace.root, plan_path),
                      "source_manifest": describe_file(workspace.root, manifest_path)},
        }
        atomic_json(directory / "receipt.json", receipt, immutable=True)
    return get(workspace, key)


def _retained(workspace, key):
    """Validate admission records and CAS bytes without materializing source views."""
    from . import observed_landcover
    key = identifier(key)
    directory = workspace.root / DIRECTORY / key
    receipt = read_json(directory / "receipt.json")
    _require(receipt.get("schema") == SCHEMA and receipt.get("state") == "complete"
             and receipt.get("id") == key == digest(receipt.get("identity"))
             and receipt.get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"]
             and receipt["identity"].get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"],
             "Choose an original local comparison admission in this project")
    identity = receipt["identity"]
    _require(receipt["title"] == identity["title"]
             and receipt["original_source"] == identity["source"]
             and receipt["original_source_body_sha256"] == identity["source_body_sha256"]
             and receipt["source_project_id"] == identity["captured_lineage"]["source_project_id"]
             and receipt["original_selection_id"] == identity["captured_lineage"]["observed_landcover_selection_id"],
             "The admission changed its original report identity")
    _require(receipt["files"]["source_admission"]["path"] == DIRECTORY + "/" + key + "/source-admission.json"
             and receipt["files"]["source_manifest"]["path"] == DIRECTORY + "/" + key + "/sources.json",
             "The admission points outside its original records")
    for descriptor in receipt["files"].values():
        verify_file(workspace.root, descriptor)
    plan = read_json(workspace.root / receipt["files"]["source_admission"]["path"])
    manifest = read_json(workspace.root / receipt["files"]["source_manifest"]["path"])
    _require(plan["id"] == key and plan["identity"] == identity
             and plan["created_at"] == receipt["created_at"]
             and manifest == _manifest(identity, key, plan["original_inputs"], receipt["created_at"]),
             "The admitted original source manifest changed")
    imported = workspace._get("sources", receipt["input_collection_id"])
    _require(imported["scope"]["received_landcover_copy"] == {"id": key, "identity": identity},
             "The local source collection lost its original admission")
    original = workspace._get("sources", receipt["original_source"]["source_collection_id"])
    rows = [row for row in original["entries"] if row["id"] == receipt["original_source"]["source_id"]]
    _require(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]["body"]["sha256"] == receipt["original_source_body_sha256"],
             "The copied comparison lost its original received report")
    selection_member = next(row for row in rows[0]["companions"]
                            if row.get("view_path", row["filename"]) == "selection.json")
    captured = read_json(verify_file(workspace.root, {
        "path": selection_member["object"], "bytes": selection_member["bytes"],
        "sha256": selection_member["sha256"]}))
    local_id = identifier(receipt["local_selection_id"])
    local_prefix = observed_landcover.KIND + "/" + local_id + "/"
    edition = observed_landcover._receipt(workspace, workspace.root / local_prefix / "receipt.json")
    for descriptor in edition["files"].values():
        _require(_relative(descriptor["path"]).startswith(local_prefix),
                 "Original local comparison member escapes its saved edition")
        verify_file(workspace.root, descriptor)
    report = read_json(workspace.root / edition["files"]["selection.json"]["path"])
    _require(edition["source"] == receipt["local_source"]
             and edition["identity"]["project_id"] == workspace.project["id"]
             and report["selection"] == edition["identity"]["selection"] == receipt["selection"]
             and report["binding"] == edition["identity"]["binding"] == receipt["source_binding"]
             and report["summary"] == edition["summary"] == receipt["summary"],
             "The local editable comparison differs from its retained admission")
    entries = {row["id"]: row for row in imported["entries"]}
    originals = report["binding"]["inputs"]
    _require(len(entries) == len(imported["entries"]) == len(originals) == 4
             and report["selection"]["source_collection_id"] == receipt["input_collection_id"]
             and all(row["source_collection_id"] == receipt["input_collection_id"]
                     and entries.get(row["source_id"]) == row["entry"] for row in originals),
             "The local comparison changed its original admitted input entries")
    for entry in entries.values():
        for body in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
            verify_file(workspace.root, {"path": body["object"], "bytes": body["bytes"],
                                         "sha256": body["sha256"]})
    local_collection = workspace._get("sources", receipt["local_source"]["source_collection_id"])
    sources = [row for row in local_collection["entries"]
               if row["id"] == receipt["local_source"]["source_id"]]
    recipe = edition["files"]["observed-report.json"]
    _require(len(sources) == 1 and sources[0]["body"]["sha256"] == recipe["sha256"]
             and sources[0]["body"]["bytes"] == recipe["bytes"],
             "The local comparison lost its original report source")
    expected = {name: item for name, item in edition["files"].items()
                if name not in ("observed-report.json", "sources.json", "selected-huc-landcover.zip")}
    actual = {body.get("view_path", body["filename"]): body for body in sources[0].get("companions", [])}
    _require(len(actual) == len(sources[0].get("companions", [])) and set(actual) == set(expected)
             and all(actual[name]["sha256"] == item["sha256"] and actual[name]["bytes"] == item["bytes"]
                     for name, item in expected.items()),
             "The local comparison changed its retained report companions")
    for body in [sources[0]["body"], *sources[0].get("companions", [])]:
        verify_file(workspace.root, {"path": body["object"], "bytes": body["bytes"],
                                     "sha256": body["sha256"]})
    _same_science(captured, report)
    return {**receipt, "files": {**receipt["files"],
            "receipt": describe_file(workspace.root, directory / "receipt.json")}}


def get(workspace, key):

def include_input(closure, original_entry):
    """Retain the original-to-local admission when its local report is exported."""
    marker = (original_entry.get("metadata") or {}).get(ORIGIN_KEY)
    if marker is None:
        return False
    _require(isinstance(marker, dict) and marker.get("schema") == SCHEMA
             and marker.get("project_id") == closure.workspace.project["id"],
             "Local copied input has another project admission")
    key = identifier(marker["copy_id"])
    prefix = DIRECTORY + "/" + key + "/"
    receipt = closure.read(prefix + "receipt.json")
    _require(receipt.get("schema") == SCHEMA and receipt.get("state") == "complete"
             and receipt.get("id") == key == digest(receipt.get("identity"))
             and receipt.get("project_id") == receipt["identity"].get("project_id") == closure.workspace.project["id"]
             and receipt["original_source"] == receipt["identity"].get("source")
             and receipt["original_source_body_sha256"] == receipt["identity"].get("source_body_sha256")
             and receipt["original_source"] == marker["original_source"]
             and receipt["original_source_body_sha256"] == marker["original_source_body_sha256"]
             and receipt["source_project_id"] == marker["source_project_id"]
             and receipt["original_selection_id"] == marker["original_selection_id"],
             "Local copied input differs from its captured admission")
    for descriptor in receipt["files"].values():
        closure.add_file(descriptor["path"], descriptor)
    plan = closure.read(receipt["files"]["source_admission"]["path"])
    originals = [row for row in plan["original_inputs"]
                 if row["source_id"] == marker["original_input_source_id"]]
    _require(plan["identity"] == receipt["identity"] and len(originals) == 1
             and originals[0]["source_collection_id"] == marker["original_input_collection_id"]
             and digest(originals[0]["entry"]) == marker["original_input_entry_sha256"],
             "The admission changed its original input entry")
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + identifier(receipt["input_collection_id"]) + ".json")
    _require(digest(collection) == receipt["input_collection_id"]
             and [row for row in collection["entries"] if row["id"] == original_entry["id"]] == [original_entry],
             "The editable comparison changed its admitted source entry")
    # A revised comparison can use these admitted inputs without being the
    # first local edition named by the admission. Keep that original edition
    # and its source as well, so the admission still reopens after a selected
    # revised-only Study transfer.
    local_id = identifier(receipt["local_selection_id"])
    local_prefix = "observed-landcover-selections/" + local_id + "/"
    local = closure.read(local_prefix + "receipt.json")
    _require(local.get("schema") == "upstate.observed-landcover-selection/v1"
             and local.get("state") == "complete"
             and local.get("id") == local_id == digest(local.get("identity"))
             and local.get("project_id") == closure.workspace.project["id"]
             and local.get("source") == receipt["local_source"]
             and local["identity"].get("selection") == receipt["selection"]
             and local["identity"].get("binding") == receipt["source_binding"]
             and local.get("summary") == receipt["summary"],
             "The admission lost its original local comparison")
    for descriptor in local["files"].values():
        _require(_relative(descriptor["path"]).startswith(local_prefix),
                 "Original local comparison member escapes its saved edition")
        closure.add_file(descriptor["path"], descriptor)
    closure.tree(local_prefix.rstrip("/"))
    local_collection_id = identifier(receipt["local_source"]["source_collection_id"])
    local_collection = closure.read("sources/" + local_collection_id + ".json")
    local_entries = [row for row in local_collection["entries"]
                     if row["id"] == receipt["local_source"]["source_id"]]
    _require(digest(local_collection) == local_collection_id and len(local_entries) == 1
             and local_entries[0]["body"]["sha256"] == local["files"]["observed-report.json"]["sha256"]
             and local_entries[0]["body"]["bytes"] == local["files"]["observed-report.json"]["bytes"],
             "The admission lost its original local report source")
    closure.need("sources", local_collection_id,
                 "Original local edition retained with its admitted inputs")
    parent_id = identifier(receipt["original_source"]["source_collection_id"])
    parent = closure.read("sources/" + parent_id + ".json")
    parents = [row for row in parent["entries"] if row["id"] == receipt["original_source"]["source_id"]]
    _require(digest(parent) == parent_id and len(parents) == 1
             and parents[0]["body"]["sha256"] == receipt["original_source_body_sha256"],
             "The admission lost its original foreign source collection")
    closure.need("sources", parent_id, "Original foreign comparison retained with its explicit local copy")
    return True

"""Readable original-input custody for retained selected-HUC land-cover reports.

This module describes the source binding already checked by the maintained
producer. It never imports a source, changes a selection or computes quantities.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from .common import atomic_bytes, atomic_json, describe_file, file_digest

SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-landcover-source-provenance/v1"
ADMISSION_SCHEMA = "upstate.received-landcover-copy/v1"
EDITION = "original-landcover-source-custody/1"
DATA = "source-provenance.json"
IMPLEMENTATION = "source-provenance-implementation.py"
MARKER = "received_landcover_copy"


def _require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def implementation():
    return {"edition": EDITION, "sha256": file_digest(__file__)}


def _relative(value):
    _require(isinstance(value, str) and value and "\\" not in value and "\0" not in value,
             "Retained original source files need portable relative names")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    _require(path.parts and not path.is_absolute() and ".." not in path.parts
             and path.as_posix() == value and all(":" not in part for part in path.parts),
             "Retained original source member escapes its directory")
    return value


def _ancestry(entry):
    value = (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get(MARKER)
    result = []
    seen = set()
    while value is not None:
        _require(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") == ADMISSION_SCHEMA,
                 "Retained input has an unsupported admission history")
        for name in ("copy_id", "project_id", "source_project_id", "original_source_body_sha256",
                     "original_selection_id", "original_input_collection_id",
                     "original_input_source_id", "original_input_entry_sha256"):
            _require(isinstance(value.get(name), str) and value[name],
                     "Retained input admission is missing " + name)
        original_source = value.get("original_source")
        _require(isinstance(original_source, dict)
                 and all(isinstance(original_source.get(name), str) and original_source[name]
                         for name in ("source_collection_id", "source_id")),
                 "Retained input admission lost its original report source")
        identity = (value["project_id"], value["copy_id"], value["original_input_source_id"])
        _require(identity not in seen, "Retained input admission history repeats an edition")
        seen.add(identity)
        # Preserve every original field, while representing the linked history
        # as ordered rows for inspection. The full nested marker remains in
        # the retained source entry as well.
        result.append(deepcopy({key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != "previous"}))
        value = value.get("previous")
    return result


def describe(report, current_project_id, *, comparison_id=None):
    _require(isinstance(current_project_id, str) and current_project_id,
             "Source history needs the actual current project identifier")
    _require(comparison_id is None or isinstance(comparison_id, str) and comparison_id,
             "Source history needs the actual saved comparison identifier")
    binding = report["binding"]
    originals = binding["inputs"]
    _require(isinstance(originals, list) and len(originals) == 4,
             "The original analysis, two annual inventories and transition inventory must all be retained")
    before, after = binding["rasters"]["before"]["year"], binding["rasters"]["after"]["year"]
    roles = ("Original analysis and input identities", "Earlier annual inventory (" + str(before) + ")",
             "Later annual inventory (" + str(after) + ")", "Paired directional transitions")
    seen = set()
    inputs = []
    for index, (original, role) in enumerate(zip(originals, roles)):
        _require(isinstance(original, dict) and isinstance(original.get("entry"), dict),
                 "The original source entry must be retained in full")
        entry = original["entry"]
        identity = (original["source_collection_id"], original["source_id"])
        _require(identity not in seen and entry.get("id") == original["source_id"],
                 "The original four input sources must retain distinct matching identities")
        seen.add(identity)
        members = []
        for position, body in enumerate([entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]):
            name = _relative(body.get("view_path", body["filename"]))
            members.append({"role": "body" if position == 0 else "companion",
                            "path": "originals/" + str(index) + "/" + name,
                            "descriptor": deepcopy(body)})
        _require(len({row["path"] for row in members}) == len(members),
                 "Original input companion names collide")
        inputs.append({"role": role, "source_collection_id": original["source_collection_id"],
                       "source_id": original["source_id"], "entry": deepcopy(entry),
                       "members": members, "admission_history": _ancestry(entry)})
    imported = sum(bool(row["admission_history"]) for row in inputs)
    current_admissions = [
        row["admission_history"][0] for row in inputs
        if row["admission_history"] and row["admission_history"][0]["project_id"] == current_project_id
    ]
    relationship = ("local_copy_of_received_inputs" if len(current_admissions) == len(inputs) else
                    "retained_input_history" if imported else "original_retained_inputs")
    return {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "edition": EDITION, "current_project_id": current_project_id,
        "current_comparison_id": comparison_id, "title": report["title"],
        "relationship": relationship, "selection": deepcopy(report["selection"]),
        "original_analysis": {
            "source_collection_id": binding["source_collection_id"],
            "source_id": binding["analysis_source_id"], "sha256": binding["analysis_sha256"]},
        "rasters": deepcopy(binding["rasters"]),
        "source_domain_sha256": binding["source_domain_sha256"],
        "grid": deepcopy(binding["grid"]), "coordinate_operation": deepcopy(binding["coordinate_operation"]),
        "method": deepcopy(binding["method"]),
        "original_huc_count": binding["original_huc_count"],
        "original_overlap_cells": binding["original_overlap_cells"],
        "inputs": inputs,
        "custody": {
            "input_bytes": "Original body and companion bytes are retained; copying does not regenerate the annual analysis.",
            "local_editing": "The current comparison uses its own project and saved comparison identity. Changing the title or watershed selection creates a new comparison.",
            "foreign_report": "An explicit local admission preserves its received original report and source. The local comparison does not replace the original report.",
            "interpretation": "Source history describes custody and selection. It does not establish raster calibration, causal attribution, stream load or intake exposure.",
        },
    }


def _text(value):
    return "Not recorded" if value is None or value == "" else str(value)


def _short(value):
    value = _text(value)
    # This is a labeled display identifier, never an input to source matching.
    return value if len(value) <= 48 else value[:20] + "…" + value[-12:] + " (abbreviated)"


def sections(provenance):
    if provenance is None:
        return []
    _require(provenance.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "Choose the retained original source-history edition")
    inputs = provenance["inputs"]
    blocks = [
        "Current project: " + _text(provenance["current_project_id"]) + ".",
        "Saved comparison: " + _short(provenance.get("current_comparison_id")) + ".",
        "Selected watersheds: " + str(len(provenance["selection"]["huc12s"])) +
        "; exact identifiers are retained in the comparison tables and JSON.",
        "Original Annual NLCD product years: " + str(provenance["rasters"]["before"]["year"]) +
        " to " + str(provenance["rasters"]["after"]["year"]) + ".",
    ]
    if provenance["relationship"] == "local_copy_of_received_inputs":
        blocks.append("This is a local editable comparison of explicitly admitted, received original inputs. "
                      "The received report and its original source remain preserved. You can revise the local "
                      "watershed selection and save another comparison without replacing that original report.")
    elif provenance["relationship"] == "retained_input_history":
        blocks.append("These inputs retain earlier admission history. The project identifiers below distinguish "
                      "those earlier copies from the current project; an earlier copy is not relabeled as a current admission.")
    else:
        blocks.append("This comparison uses the original retained analysis and its three complete result documents. "
                      "No explicit received-to-local admission is recorded in these input entries.")
    blocks.extend([
        provenance["custody"]["input_bytes"],
        "The original analysis covers " + str(provenance["original_huc_count"]) +
        " watersheds. This report selects " + str(len(provenance["selection"]["huc12s"])) +
        "; the complete original inputs remain attached so another selection can be prepared.",
        {"kind": "table", "columns": ["Original input", "Original source title", "Source edition"],
         "widths": [1.6, 2.8, 1.6],
         "rows": [[row["role"], _text(row["entry"].get("title")),
                   _text(row["entry"].get("vintage"))] for row in inputs]},
    ])
    for row in inputs:
        entry = row["entry"]
        blocks.append(row["role"] + ": source " + _short(row["source_id"]) +
                      "; collection " + _short(row["source_collection_id"]) + ".")
        if entry.get("uri"):
            blocks.append("Original retained source URI: " + str(entry["uri"]) + ".")
        blocks.append("Retained files: " + str(len(row["members"])) +
                      " (original body plus " + str(len(row["members"]) - 1) + " companions).")
    # Present common admission steps once, with all participating input roles.
    # Per-input entry digests and full nested history remain in the JSON.
    steps = {}
    for row in inputs:
        for admission in row["admission_history"]:
            key = (admission["project_id"], admission["copy_id"])
            if key not in steps:
                steps[key] = {"admission": admission, "roles": []}
            item = steps[key]
            for field in ("source_project_id", "original_selection_id", "original_source",
                          "original_source_body_sha256"):
                _require(item["admission"][field] == admission[field],
                         "Shared admission history disagrees about its original report")
            item["roles"].append(row["role"])
    for ordinal, item in enumerate(steps.values(), 1):
        admission = item["admission"]
        blocks.extend([
            "Retained admission " + str(ordinal) + ": " + _short(admission["copy_id"]) +
            ". Receiving project: " + admission["project_id"] +
            ". Original report project: " + admission["source_project_id"] + ".",
            "Original saved comparison: " + _short(admission["original_selection_id"]) +
            ". Original report source: " + _short(admission["original_source"]["source_id"]) +
            "; collection " + _short(admission["original_source"]["source_collection_id"]) + ".",
            "Inputs in this admission: " + "; ".join(item["roles"]) + ".",
        ])
    if steps:
        blocks.append("Shared admission steps are grouped here. Each input's full ordered history runs from its most recent "
                      "retained admission toward earlier copies in the source-history JSON.")
    blocks.extend([
        provenance["custody"]["interpretation"],
        "Full identifiers, exact hashes, publisher metadata, original body and companion descriptors, "
        "and every retained admission step are available in the linked JSON. Display abbreviations do not change source identity.",
        {"kind": "links", "items": [
            {"title": "Complete source custody and admission history", "path": DATA},
            {"title": "Original analysis and all four input bindings", "path": "original-inputs.json"},
            {"title": "Saved comparison and exact scientific quantities", "path": "selection.json"},
        ]},
    ])
    return [["Original inputs and editable comparison history", blocks]]


def retain(directory, report, expected_implementation):
    _require(implementation() == expected_implementation,
             "The source-history implementation changed during report preparation")
    provenance = report.get("source_provenance")
    _require(provenance is not None and provenance.get("schema") == SCHEMA,
             "The new saved comparison needs its original source-history binding")
    # Validate readable ancestry before publishing its immutable representation.
    sections(provenance)
    atomic_json(directory / DATA, provenance, immutable=True)
    atomic_bytes(directory / IMPLEMENTATION, Path(__file__).read_bytes(), immutable=True)
    return {name: describe_file(directory, directory / name) for name in (DATA, IMPLEMENTATION)}

"""Original selected-HUC comparisons inside the maintained received-Study view.

All values come from the saved source report. The selected Study resolver remains
the source and dependency authority; this reader adds navigation and file tickets.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier

CONTEXT = "observed_landcover_selection"
KIND = "observed-landcover-selections"
SCHEMA = "upstate.received-observed-landcover/v1"


def summary(identity):
    rows = [row for row in identity.get("scientific_report_sources", [])
            if row.get("report_context_kind") == CONTEXT]
    return {
        "observed_landcover_source_count": len(rows),
        "editable_observed_landcover_count": len({
            row["observed_landcover_selection_id"] for row in rows
            if row.get("relationship") == "same_project"}),
    }


def _files(closure, descriptors):
    rows = {}
    for item in descriptors:
        path = item["path"]
        closure.add_file(path, item)
        retained = closure.files[path]
        label = item.get("label") or PurePosixPath(path).name
        rows[(path, label)] = {"path": path, "bytes": retained["bytes"],
                              "sha256": retained["sha256"], "label": label}
    return [rows[key] for key in sorted(rows)]


def _small_summary(value):
    # The native 16 x 16 matrix stays in the original files and saved desk.
    # Retain support, areas and ratios exactly; do not recompute their denominator.
    return {key: deepcopy(item) for key, item in value.items()
            if key not in ("classes", "transitions", "huc12", "properties")}


def _source(closure, captured):
    collection_id = identifier(captured["source_collection_id"])
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
    if digest(collection) != collection_id:
        raise ValueError("The received land-cover source collection changed.")
    matches = [row for row in collection.get("entries", [])
               if row.get("id") == captured["source_id"]]
    if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0]["body"]["sha256"] != captured["source_body_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The received land-cover report lost its exact original source.")
    entry = matches[0]
    if (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("source_kind") != KIND:
        raise ValueError("Choose an original selected-watershed land-cover source.")
    companions = {}
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        name = item.get("view_path", item["filename"])
        if name in companions:
            raise ValueError("The received land-cover source repeats a companion.")
        companions[name] = item
    descriptor = companions.get("selection.json")
    if descriptor is None:
        raise ValueError("The received land-cover source lacks its complete saved selection.")
    closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
    report = closure.read(descriptor["object"])
    if (report.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-landcover-selection/v1"
            or report.get("selection") != captured["selection"]):
        raise ValueError("The received land-cover report changed its selected watersheds.")
    return entry, report


def augment(closure, retained, result):
    """Add exact captured sources after receipt verification, before final recheck."""
    identity = retained["identity"]
    captured_rows = [row for row in identity.get("scientific_report_sources", [])
                     if row.get("report_context_kind") == CONTEXT]
    resolved = getattr(closure, "report_source_records", {})
    result.update(summary(identity))
    result["observed_landcover_sources"] = []
    for captured in captured_rows:
        token = (captured["source_collection_id"], captured["source_id"])
        if resolved.get(token) != captured:
            raise ValueError("The received Study changed its selected-watershed source lineage.")
        entry, report = _source(closure, captured)
        source = {"source_collection_id": token[0], "source_id": token[1]}
        binding = report["binding"]
        row = {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "title": report["title"], "source": source,
            "source_project_id": captured["source_project_id"],
            "relationship": captured["relationship"],
            "source_body_sha256": captured["source_body_sha256"],
            "selection_id": captured["observed_landcover_selection_id"],
            "selection": deepcopy(report["selection"]),
            "source_binding": {name: deepcopy(binding[name]) for name in
                               ("analysis_sha256", "source_domain_sha256", "rasters", "grid", "method")},
            "summary": _small_summary(report["summary"]),
            "watersheds": [{"huc12": item["huc12"],
                            "properties": deepcopy(item.get("properties", {})),
                            "summary": _small_summary(item)}
                           for item in report["watersheds"]],
            "interpretation": report["interpretation"],
            "lineage": deepcopy(captured), "native": None,
            "report_ids": [item["id"] for item in result.get("reports", [])
                           if source in item.get("source_choices", [])],
        }
        # Keep original logical filenames even when CAS bodies share bytes.
        row["source_members"] = _files(closure, [
            {**item, "path": item["object"],
             "label": item.get("view_path", item["filename"])}
            for item in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]
        ])
        if captured["relationship"] == "same_project":
            if captured["source_project_id"] != closure.workspace.project["id"]:
                raise ValueError("Editable watershed selection belongs to another project.")
            from . import observed_landcover
            key = identifier(captured["observed_landcover_selection_id"])
            inspected = observed_landcover.inspect(closure.workspace, key)
            edition = inspected["edition"]
            if inspected["report"] != report or edition["huc12s"] != report["selection"]["huc12s"]:
                raise ValueError("The original editable watershed comparison changed.")
            prefix = KIND + "/" + key + "/"
            members = [{**item, "label": name} for name, item in edition["files"].items()]
            closure.read(prefix + "receipt.json")
            original = closure.files[prefix + "receipt.json"]
            members.append({"path": prefix + "receipt.json", "bytes": original["bytes"],
                            "sha256": original["sha256"], "label": "receipt.json"})
            row["native"] = {
                "id": key, "title": edition["title"], "source": deepcopy(edition["source"]),
                "huc12s": deepcopy(edition["huc12s"]), "members": _files(closure, members),
            }
        elif captured["relationship"] != "external_project":
            raise ValueError("Choose a supported original watershed source relationship.")
        from .observed_landcover_local_copy import list_copies
        row["local_copies"] = list_copies(closure.workspace, study_id=retained["id"], source=source)
        result["observed_landcover_sources"].append(row)
    return result

from copy import deepcopy

EDITION = "original-huc-group-report/1"
SPEC = "figures/selected-group-figures.json"
DATA = "figures/selected-group-data.json"
CSV = "landcover-groups.csv"
GROUPS = (
    ("water", "Water", (11,)), ("snow_ice", "Snow / ice", (12,)),
    ("developed", "Developed", (21, 22, 23, 24)), ("barren", "Barren", (31,)),
    ("forest", "Forest", (41, 42, 43)), ("shrub", "Shrub", (52,)),
    ("grass", "Grass", (71,)), ("agriculture", "Agriculture", (81, 82)),
    ("wetland", "Wetland", (90, 95)),
)


def implementation():
    from reportlab import Version
    from . import scientific_figures
    return {"edition": EDITION, "reportlab_version": Version,
            "group_report_sha256": file_digest(__file__),
            "scientific_figures_sha256": file_digest(scientific_figures.__file__)}


def groups(view, area):
    """Aggregate original integer cells before deriving any area or percentage."""
    if isinstance(area, bool) or not isinstance(area, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(area) or area <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Original group report needs its positive native cell area")
    rows = [{"id": key, "label": label, "codes": list(codes),
             "before_cells": 0, "after_cells": 0, "retained_within_group_cells": 0,
             "internal_class_change_cells": 0, "gross_loss_cells": 0, "gross_gain_cells": 0}
            for key, label, codes in GROUPS]
    by_class = {code: row for row in rows for code in row["codes"]}
    seen, paired, changed, changed_group = set(), 0, 0, 0
    for item in view["transitions"]:
        pair = item["before_class"], item["after_class"]
        cells = item["cells"]
        if (pair in seen or pair[0] not in by_class or pair[1] not in by_class
                or isinstance(cells, bool) or not isinstance(cells, int) or cells < 0):
            raise ValueError("Group report needs all original distinct nonnegative class counts")
        expected_area = cells * area / 10000
        if not math.isclose(item["area_ha"], expected_area, rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-9):
            raise ValueError("Original transition area differs from native cell support")
        seen.add(pair)
        before, after = by_class[pair[0]], by_class[pair[1]]
        paired += cells
        changed += cells if pair[0] != pair[1] else 0
        before["before_cells"] += cells
        after["after_cells"] += cells
        if before is after:
            before["retained_within_group_cells"] += cells
            before["internal_class_change_cells"] += cells if pair[0] != pair[1] else 0
        else:
            before["gross_loss_cells"] += cells
            after["gross_gain_cells"] += cells
            changed_group += cells
    if (len(seen) != len(by_class) ** 2 or paired != view["paired_valid_cells"]
            or changed != view["changed_class_cells"]):
        raise ValueError("Group report matrix differs from complete original support")
    percent = lambda numerator, denominator: 100 * numerator / denominator if denominator else None
    for row in rows:
        row["net_cells"] = row["after_cells"] - row["before_cells"]
        row["gross_turnover_cells"] = row["gross_gain_cells"] + row["gross_loss_cells"]
        for field, cell_field in (
                ("before_area_ha", "before_cells"), ("after_area_ha", "after_cells"),
                ("retained_area_ha", "retained_within_group_cells"),
                ("internal_class_change_area_ha", "internal_class_change_cells"),
                ("gross_loss_area_ha", "gross_loss_cells"), ("gross_gain_area_ha", "gross_gain_cells"),
                ("net_area_ha", "net_cells"), ("gross_turnover_area_ha", "gross_turnover_cells")):
            row[field] = row[cell_field] * area / 10000
        row["loss_percent_of_before_group"] = percent(row["gross_loss_cells"], row["before_cells"])
        row["gain_percent_of_after_group"] = percent(row["gross_gain_cells"], row["after_cells"])
        row["net_percent_of_paired_valid"] = percent(row["net_cells"], paired)
    return {"paired_valid_cells": paired, "changed_class_cells": changed,
            "changed_group_cells": changed_group, "within_group_class_change_cells": changed - changed_group,
            "rows": rows}


def _table(columns, rows, caption):
    def value(item):
        if item is None:
            return "Not available"
        return format(item, ",.3f") if isinstance(item, float) else str(item)
    return {"kind": "table", "caption": caption, "columns": columns,
            "rows": [[value(item) for item in row] for row in rows]}


def _axis(label, unit, low, high, ticks=None):
    return {"label": label, "unit": unit, "domain": [low, high],
            "ticks": ticks if ticks is not None else [
                {"value": low + (high - low) * index / 4,
                 "label": format(low + (high - low) * index / 4, ".4g")} for index in range(5)]}


def _figures(report, selected, selection_file, data_file):
    rows = selected["rows"]
    group_ticks = [{"value": index, "label": "G" + str(index + 1)} for index in range(len(rows))]
    years = report["binding"]["rasters"]
    before, after = str(years["before"]["year"]), str(years["after"]["year"])
    common = {"selection": deepcopy(report["selection"]), "inputs": [selection_file, data_file]}
    key = "; ".join("G" + str(index + 1) + " " + row["label"] for index, row in enumerate(rows)) + "."
    def points(field, offset=0, sign=1):
        return [{"x": index + offset, "y": sign * row[field], "group": row["id"],
                 "quantity": field, "source_path": DATA, "source_scope": "selected"}
                for index, row in enumerate(rows)]
    extent = max([max(row["gross_loss_area_ha"], row["gross_gain_area_ha"],
                      abs(row["net_area_ha"])) for row in rows] + [0])
    extent = extent * 1.1 if extent else 1
    change = {"id": "selected-group-change", "title": "Gross gains, losses and net group change",
        "caption": before + " to " + after + ". Loss is plotted below zero, gain above zero, and net as a diamond. "
            "Gains and losses include only crossings between the nine groups. Changes between classes inside one "
            "group remain in that group. All quantities use original paired-valid native cells. " + key,
        **common,
        "panels": [{"title": "Selected watershed union",
            "x": _axis("Land-cover group", "", -.6, len(rows) - .4, group_ticks),
            "y": _axis("Area change", "ha", -extent, extent),
            "reference_lines": [{"axis": "y", "value": 0}],
            "series": [
                {"geometry": "scatter", "label": "Gross loss", "marker": "circle-open",
                 "points": points("gross_loss_area_ha", -.14, -1)},
                {"geometry": "scatter", "label": "Gross gain", "marker": "square",
                 "points": points("gross_gain_area_ha", .14)},
                {"geometry": "scatter", "label": "Net change", "marker": "diamond",
                 "points": points("net_area_ha")}]}],
        "detail_tables": [
            _table(["Key / group", "NLCD classes", "Gross loss (ha)", "Gross gain (ha)", "Net change (ha)"],
                   [["G" + str(index + 1) + " " + row["label"], ", ".join(map(str, row["codes"])),
                     row["gross_loss_area_ha"], row["gross_gain_area_ha"], row["net_area_ha"]]
                    for index, row in enumerate(rows)],
                   "Original selected union; three-decimal display. Exact cells and values are in landcover-groups.csv."),
            _table(["Group", "Loss / earlier group (%)", "Gain / later group (%)", "Within-group class change (ha)"],
                   [[row["label"], row["loss_percent_of_before_group"], row["gain_percent_of_after_group"],
                     row["internal_class_change_area_ha"]] for row in rows],
                   "Earlier and later group areas are separate denominators. Zero denominators remain unavailable.")
        ]}
    height = max([max(row["before_area_ha"], row["after_area_ha"]) for row in rows] + [0])
    areas = {"id": "selected-group-area", "title": "Group areas on the same paired support",
        "caption": before + " uses open circles and " + after + " uses filled squares. "
            "These are row and column margins of the original directional matrix, excluding cells valid in only "
            "one year. The independent annual inventories remain in huc-classes.csv. " + key,
        **common,
        "panels": [{"title": "Selected watershed union",
            "x": _axis("Land-cover group", "", -.6, len(rows) - .4, group_ticks),
            "y": _axis("Paired area", "ha", 0, height * 1.08 if height else 1),
            "series": [
                {"geometry": "scatter", "label": before, "marker": "circle-open",
                 "points": points("before_area_ha", -.12)},
                {"geometry": "scatter", "label": after, "marker": "square",
                 "points": points("after_area_ha", .12)}]}],
        "detail_tables": [_table(["Key / group", before + " paired (ha)", after + " paired (ha)", "Retained in group (ha)"],
            [["G" + str(index + 1) + " " + row["label"], row["before_area_ha"],
              row["after_area_ha"], row["retained_area_ha"]] for index, row in enumerate(rows)],
            "Retained includes all cells staying within the group, including changes between its constituent classes.")]}
    return [change, areas]


def prepare(directory, report, expected_implementation):
    from reportlab.graphics import renderSVG
    from . import scientific_figures
    directory = Path(directory)
    if implementation() != expected_implementation:
        raise ValueError("Selected watershed report implementation changed during production")
    area = report["binding"]["method"]["cell_area_m2"]
    selected = groups(report["summary"], area)
    watersheds = [{"huc12": row["huc12"], "properties": deepcopy(row["properties"]),
                   **groups(row, area)} for row in report["watersheds"]]
    data = {"schema": "upstate.original-huc-group-data/v1", "edition": EDITION,
            "selection": deepcopy(report["selection"]), "binding": deepcopy(report["binding"]),
            "cell_area_m2": area, "selected": selected, "watersheds": watersheds}
    atomic_json(directory / DATA, data, immutable=True)
    selection_file = describe_file(directory, directory / "selection.json")
    data_file = describe_file(directory, directory / DATA)
    figures = _figures(report, selected, selection_file, data_file)
    spec = {"schema": "upstate.scientific-figure-spec/v1", "edition": EDITION,
            "title": report["title"], "implementation": deepcopy(expected_implementation),
            "rendering": {"width_points": 511.2}, "figures": figures}
    atomic_json(directory / SPEC, spec, immutable=True)
    fields = list(selected["rows"][0])
    stream = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(stream, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["scope", "huc12", "paired_valid_cells", "changed_class_cells",
                     "changed_group_cells", "within_group_class_change_cells", *fields])
    for scope, huc12, value in [("selected", "", selected),
                               *[("watershed", row["huc12"], row) for row in watersheds]]:
        for row in value["rows"]:
            writer.writerow([scope, huc12, *[value[key] for key in
                ("paired_valid_cells", "changed_class_cells", "changed_group_cells", "within_group_class_change_cells")],
                *[",".join(map(str, row[field])) if field == "codes" else row[field] for field in fields]])
    atomic_bytes(directory / CSV, stream.getvalue().encode("utf-8"), immutable=True)
    files = {name: describe_file(directory, directory / name) for name in (SPEC, DATA, CSV)}
    choices, svg_bodies = [], {}
    for figure in figures:
        drawings = scientific_figures.panel_drawings(figure, 511.2)
        if len(drawings) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Each selected watershed figure needs one complete original panel")
        name = "figures/" + figure["id"] + ".svg"
        body = renderSVG.drawToString(drawings[0])
        svg_bodies[figure["id"]] = body if isinstance(body, str) else body.decode("utf-8")
        atomic_bytes(directory / name, body.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(body, str) else body, immutable=True)
        files[name] = describe_file(directory, directory / name)
        choices.append({"id": figure["id"], "path": name})
    for name, module_path, expected in (
            ("observed_landcover_report.py", __file__, expected_implementation["group_report_sha256"]),
            ("scientific_figures.py", scientific_figures.__file__, expected_implementation["scientific_figures_sha256"])):
        if file_digest(module_path) != expected:
            raise ValueError("Selected group report source changed during capture")
        member = "implementation/" + name
        atomic_bytes(directory / member, Path(module_path).read_bytes(), immutable=True)
        files[member] = describe_file(directory, directory / member)
        if files[member]["sha256"] != expected:
            raise ValueError("Captured selected group implementation differs")
    for descriptor in files.values():
        verify_file(directory, descriptor)
    return {"figure_spec": SPEC, "figures": choices, "files": files, "spec": spec, "svg": svg_bodies}

"""Retain editable original selected-HUC comparisons in scientific Study exports.

The existing Study closure captures raw CAS bodies and exact saved records. This
adapter does not rebuild comparisons, render figures, or open raster datasets.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier

KIND = "observed-landcover-selections"
SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-landcover-selection/v1"
REPORT_SCHEMA = "upstate.observed-report/v1"
EDITION = "original-huc-nlcd-selection/1"


def _require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def _relative(value):
    _require(isinstance(value, str) and "\\" not in value and "\0" not in value,
             "Selected watershed members need original relative paths")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    _require(not path.is_absolute() and bool(path.parts) and ".." not in path.parts
             and path.as_posix() == value and all(":" not in part for part in path.parts),
             "Selected watershed member escapes its original directory")
    return value


def _same(first, second):
    return all(first.get(name) == second.get(name) for name in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _body(closure, descriptor):
    closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
    return closure.read(descriptor["object"])


def _members(closure, entry, recipe):
    members = {}
    for descriptor in entry.get("companions", []):
        path = _relative(descriptor.get("view_path", descriptor["filename"]))
        _require(path not in members, "Selected watershed source repeats a companion")
        closure.add_file(descriptor["object"], descriptor)
        members[path] = descriptor
    requested = recipe.get("inputs")
    _require(isinstance(requested, list) and bool(requested),
             "Selected watershed report lacks its original input inventory")
    declared = {}
    for descriptor in requested:
        path = _relative(descriptor["path"])
        _require(path not in declared and path in members and _same(descriptor, members[path]),
                 "Selected watershed report lost an exact original input: " + path)
        declared[path] = descriptor
    _require(set(declared) == set(members),
             "Selected watershed report companion inventory differs")
    return members


def _captured(closure, collection_id, entry):
    recipe = _body(closure, entry["body"])
    origin = recipe.get("origin", {})
    key = identifier(origin.get("id"))
    project_id = origin.get("project_id")
    _require(entry.get("kind") == "document" and entry.get("role") == "OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
             and recipe.get("schema") == REPORT_SCHEMA and recipe.get("edition") == EDITION
             and origin.get("kind") == KIND
             and (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("origin") == origin
             and isinstance(project_id, str) and bool(project_id)
             and entry.get("id") == "selected-huc-landcover-" + key
             and entry.get("uri") == "workspace://" + project_id + "/" + KIND + "/" + key,
             "Selected watershed report differs from its original producer")
    members = _members(closure, entry, recipe)

    def original(name):
        _require(name in members, "Selected watershed report lacks " + name)
        return _body(closure, members[name])

    report = original("selection.json")
    binding = original("original-inputs.json")
    selection = report.get("selection", {})
    hucs = selection.get("huc12s")
    _require(report.get("schema") == SCHEMA and report.get("edition") == EDITION
             and report.get("title") == recipe.get("title")
             and report.get("binding") == binding
             and isinstance(hucs, list) and bool(hucs)
             and all(isinstance(huc, str) and len(huc) == 12 and huc.isascii()
                     and huc.isdigit() for huc in hucs)
             and hucs == sorted(set(hucs)) and origin.get("huc12s") == hucs
             and origin.get("area_method") == "original_native_cell_centre"
             and [row.get("huc12") for row in report.get("watersheds", [])] == hucs,
             "Selected watershed report changed its original selection or support")
    for field in ("source_collection_id", "analysis_source_id", "analysis_sha256"):
        _require(selection.get(field) == binding.get(field),
                 "Selected watershed report changed its original " + field)
    identifier(binding["source_collection_id"])
    identifier(binding["analysis_sha256"])
    identifier(binding["source_domain_sha256"])
    originals = binding.get("inputs")
    _require(isinstance(originals, list) and len(originals) == 4,
             "Selected watershed report needs its four original completed input records")
    roster = {}
    for index, row in enumerate(originals):
        collection = identifier(row["source_collection_id"])
        source_id = row["source_id"]
        original_entry = row["entry"]
        _require(isinstance(source_id, str) and bool(source_id)
                 and original_entry.get("id") == source_id
                 and collection == binding["source_collection_id"],
                 "Selected watershed input changed its original collection or source")
        token = (collection, source_id)
        _require(token not in roster, "Selected watershed report repeats an original input")
        roster[token] = original_entry
        for descriptor in [original_entry["body"], *original_entry.get("companions", [])]:
            name = "originals/" + str(index) + "/" + _relative(
                descriptor.get("view_path", descriptor["filename"]))
            _require(name in members and _same(descriptor, members[name]),
                     "Selected watershed report lost an original input body: " + name)
    analysis = roster.get((binding["source_collection_id"], binding["analysis_source_id"]))
    _require(analysis is not None
             and analysis["body"]["sha256"] == binding["analysis_sha256"],
             "Selected watershed report lost its exact original analysis-run identity")
    return origin, recipe, members, report, binding, roster


def _local(closure, entry, origin, recipe, members, report, binding, roster):
    key = origin["id"]
    prefix = KIND + "/" + key + "/"
    receipt = closure.read(prefix + "receipt.json")
    identity = receipt.get("identity", {})
    _require(receipt.get("schema") == SCHEMA and receipt.get("state") == "complete"
             and receipt.get("id") == key == digest(identity)
             and receipt.get("project_id") == origin["project_id"]
             and identity.get("project_id") == origin["project_id"]
             and identity.get("edition") == EDITION
             and identity.get("title") == receipt.get("title") == report["title"]
             and identity.get("selection") == report["selection"]
             and identity.get("binding") == binding
             and receipt.get("huc12s") == report["selection"]["huc12s"]
             and receipt.get("summary") == report.get("summary"),
             "Editable selected watershed receipt differs from its captured report")
    identifier(identity.get("producer_sha256"))
    files = receipt.get("files")
    _require(isinstance(files, dict) and bool(files),
             "Editable selected watershed comparison lacks its original files")
    extras = {"observed-report.json", "sources.json", "selected-huc-landcover.zip"}
    _require(set(files) == set(members) | extras,
             "Editable selected watershed file inventory changed")
    for name, descriptor in files.items():
        name = _relative(name)
        _require(descriptor.get("path") == prefix + name,
                 "Editable selected watershed file belongs to another comparison")
        if name in members:
            _require(_same(descriptor, members[name]),
                     "Editable selected watershed file differs from its captured source")
        closure.add_file(descriptor["path"], descriptor)
    _require(_same(files["observed-report.json"], entry["body"])
             and closure.read(prefix + "observed-report.json") == recipe
             and closure.read(prefix + "selection.json") == report
             and closure.read(prefix + "original-inputs.json") == binding,
             "Editable selected watershed originals differ from their report source")

    source = receipt["source"]
    source_collection = identifier(source["source_collection_id"])
    collection = closure.read("sources/" + source_collection + ".json")
    retained = [row for row in collection.get("entries", [])
                if row.get("id") == source.get("source_id")]
    _require(collection.get("schema") == "upstate.sources/v1"
             and digest(collection) == source_collection
             and source.get("source_id") == entry["id"] and len(retained) == 1
             and _same(retained[0]["body"], entry["body"]),
             "Editable selected watershed comparison lost its original report collection")
    native_members = {}
    for descriptor in retained[0].get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(descriptor.get("view_path", descriptor["filename"]))
        _require(name not in native_members, "Original selected report repeats a companion")
        native_members[name] = descriptor
    _require(set(native_members) == set(members)
             and all(_same(native_members[name], item) for name, item in members.items()),
             "Editable selected watershed report changed its captured companion set")
    observed_binding = receipt.get("observed_binding")
    # The ordinary observed binding uses its formatter binding edition rather
    # than this producer's edition. Compare its complete source/member portion.
    _require(isinstance(observed_binding, dict)
             and observed_binding.get("schema") == "upstate.observed-report-binding/v1"
             and isinstance(observed_binding.get("edition"), str)
             and bool(observed_binding["edition"])
             and observed_binding.get("source_collection_id") == source_collection
             and observed_binding.get("source_id") == entry["id"]
             and observed_binding.get("body_sha256") == entry["body"]["sha256"]
             and observed_binding.get("member_sha256") == {
                 **{name: item["sha256"] for name, item in native_members.items()},
                 _relative(retained[0]["body"].get("view_path", retained[0]["body"]["filename"])):
                     retained[0]["body"]["sha256"]},
             "Editable selected watershed scientific binding differs")
    required = {source_collection}
    for (collection_id, source_id), original in roster.items():
        current = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
        choices = [row for row in current.get("entries", []) if row.get("id") == source_id]
        _require(current.get("schema") == "upstate.sources/v1" and digest(current) == collection_id
                 and choices == [original],
                 "Editable selected watershed input differs from the captured original")
        required.add(collection_id)
        from .observed_landcover_local_copy import include_input
        include_input(closure, original)
    for collection_id in sorted(required):
        closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Original selected-watershed analysis or report collection")
    # The existing closure records every member and detects directory changes.
    closure.tree(prefix.rstrip("/"))
    return [{"kind": "sources", "id": value} for value in sorted(required)]


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    """Join only this exact producer behind an explicitly selected report."""
    if (entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("source_kind") != KIND:
        return False
    identifier(collection_id)
    origin, recipe, members, report, binding, roster = _captured(closure, collection_id, entry)
    local = origin["project_id"] == closure.workspace.project["id"]
    required = _local(closure, entry, origin, recipe, members, report, binding, roster) if local else []
    lineage = {
        "schema": "upstate.study-report-lineage/v1",
        "source_collection_id": collection_id,
        "source_id": entry["id"],
        "source_body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"],
        "source_project_id": origin["project_id"],
        "report_context_kind": "observed_landcover_selection",
        "observed_landcover_selection_id": origin["id"],
        "producer_edition": recipe["edition"],
        "relationship": "same_project" if local else "external_project",
        "required_records": required,
        "selection": deepcopy(report["selection"]),
        "area_method": origin["area_method"],
        "original_input_sources": [
            {"source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": source_id,
             "body_sha256": original["body"]["sha256"]}
            for (collection_id, source_id), original in roster.items()
        ],
        "original_members": {name: members[name]["sha256"] for name in sorted(members)},
    }
    token = (collection_id, entry["id"])
    previous = closure.report_source_records.get(token)
    _require(previous is None or previous == lineage,
             "Selected watershed lineage changed during Study selection")
    closure.report_source_records[token] = lineage
    return True
