INPUT_ROLE = "LANDCOVER_OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
RUN_SCHEMA = "upstate.original-landcover-analysis-run/v1"
ANNUAL_SCHEMA = "upstate.landcover-zonal-summary/v1"
TRANSITION_SCHEMA = "upstate.annual-landcover-transitions/v1"
PUBLISHED = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "observations/landcover_2023_2025/model-sources.json"
CLASS_SOURCE = "https://pubs.usgs.gov/fs/2025/3001/fs20253001.pdf"
CLASSES = {
    11: "Open water", 12: "Perennial ice/snow", 21: "Developed, open space",
    22: "Developed, low intensity", 23: "Developed, medium intensity",
    24: "Developed, high intensity", 31: "Barren land, rock/sand/clay",
    41: "Deciduous forest", 42: "Evergreen forest", 43: "Mixed forest",
    52: "Shrub/scrub", 71: "Grasslands/herbaceous", 81: "Pasture/hay",
    82: "Cultivated crops", 90: "Woody wetlands", 95: "Emergent herbaceous wetlands",
}
CODES = tuple(CLASSES)
SUPPORT = ("selected_cells", "paired_valid_cells", "valid_before_only_cells",
           "valid_after_only_cells", "both_nodata_cells", "stable_class_cells",
           "changed_class_cells")
INTERPRETATION = (
    "Annual product class transitions. A changed classification alone does not identify "
    "cause, timing within the interval, or classification accuracy. Areas use the original "
    "native-cell centre inclusion rule. These are categorical observations, not estimates "
    "of pollutant export or fractional polygon-overlap areas."
)


def _require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def _integer(value, label):
    _require(isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value >= 0,
             label + " must be an original nonnegative integer count")
    return value


def _near(value, expected, label):
    _require(isinstance(value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
             and math.isfinite(value) and math.isclose(value, expected, rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-7),
             label + " differs from its original cell count and affine area")


def _relative(value):
    _require(isinstance(value, str) and "\\" not in value and "\0" not in value,
             "Use an original relative source member")
    p = PurePosixPath(value)
    _require(not p.is_absolute() and p.parts and ".." not in p.parts
             and p.as_posix() == value, "Original member is not a canonical relative path")
    return value


def _indexed(rows, key, label):
    _require(isinstance(rows, list), label + " needs its original rows")
    result = {}
    for row in rows:
        _require(isinstance(row, dict) and key in row, label + " has an incomplete row")
        value = row[key]
        _require(isinstance(value, (str, int)) and not isinstance(value, bool)
                 and value not in result, label + " has a duplicate or invalid identifier")
        result[value] = row
    return result


def _annual(row, area):
    selected = _integer(row["selected_cells"], "Annual selected cells")
    nodata = _integer(row["nodata_cells"], "Annual NoData cells")
    _require(nodata <= selected, "Annual NoData exceeds original selected support")
    classes = _indexed(row["classes"], "class_code", "Annual classes")
    _require(set(classes) == set(CODES), "Annual class inventory differs from the original sixteen classes")
    counts = {}
    for code, value in classes.items():
        counts[code] = _integer(value["cells"], "Annual class")
        _near(value["area_m2"], counts[code] * area, "Annual class square metres")
        _near(value["area_ha"], counts[code] * area / 10000, "Annual class hectares")
    _require(sum(counts.values()) + nodata == selected, "Annual class margins do not cover original support")
    _near(row["area_m2"], selected * area, "Annual selected square metres")
    _near(row["valid_area_m2"], (selected - nodata) * area, "Annual valid square metres")
    return counts


def _validate_row(row, before, after, area):
    values = {key: _integer(row[key], key) for key in SUPPORT}
    selected, paired = values["selected_cells"], values["paired_valid_cells"]
    _require(paired + values["valid_before_only_cells"] + values["valid_after_only_cells"]
             + values["both_nodata_cells"] == selected, "Original paired and missing-cell support does not close")
    _require(values["stable_class_cells"] + values["changed_class_cells"] == paired,
             "Stable and changed cells do not cover original paired support")
    a, b = _annual(before, area), _annual(after, area)
    _require(before["selected_cells"] == after["selected_cells"] == selected,
             "Annual and paired comparisons use different original cell selections")
    _require(before["nodata_cells"] == values["valid_after_only_cells"] + values["both_nodata_cells"]
             and after["nodata_cells"] == values["valid_before_only_cells"] + values["both_nodata_cells"],
             "Paired NoData does not match both independent annual inventories")
    matrix = {}
    for item in row["transitions"]:
        pair = (item.get("before_class"), item.get("after_class"))
        _require(pair[0] in CLASSES and pair[1] in CLASSES and pair not in matrix,
                 "Original transition pairs must occur once across all sixteen classes")
        matrix[pair] = _integer(item["cells"], "Transition cells")
        _near(item["area_ha"], matrix[pair] * area / 10000, "Transition hectares")
    _require(set(matrix) == {(x, y) for x in CODES for y in CODES},
             "Retain all 256 original transition pairs, including zero cells")
    _require(sum(matrix.values()) == paired and
             sum(matrix[x, x] for x in CODES) == values["stable_class_cells"],
             "Original directional matrix differs from paired/stable support")
    margins = _indexed(row["classes"], "class_code", "Paired classes")
    _require(set(margins) == set(CODES), "Paired class inventory differs")
    unmatched_before = unmatched_after = 0
    for code in CODES:
        left = sum(matrix[code, x] for x in CODES)
        right = sum(matrix[x, code] for x in CODES)
        value = margins[code]
        _require(value["before_cells"] == left and value["after_cells"] == right
                 and value["net_cells"] == right - left, "Original transition margins differ")
        _near(value["before_area_ha"], left * area / 10000, "Paired before hectares")
        _near(value["after_area_ha"], right * area / 10000, "Paired after hectares")
        _near(value["net_area_ha"], (right - left) * area / 10000, "Paired net hectares")
        _require(a[code] >= left and b[code] >= right, "Paired class support exceeds independent annual support")
        unmatched_before += a[code] - left
        unmatched_after += b[code] - right
    _require(unmatched_before == values["valid_before_only_cells"]
             and unmatched_after == values["valid_after_only_cells"],
             "Unmatched annual class margins do not equal the declared unpaired support")
    _near(row["paired_valid_area_ha"], paired * area / 10000, "Paired valid hectares")
    if paired:
        _near(row["changed_percent_of_paired_valid"], 100 * values["changed_class_cells"] / paired,
              "Changed percentage")
    else:
        _require(row["changed_percent_of_paired_valid"] is None, "Empty paired support must retain an unknown percentage")
    return matrix


def _source(workspace, collection, source_id):
    path, entry = workspace.source_file(collection["id"], source_id)
    _require(entry["kind"] in ("table", "document"), "Choose the original completed land-cover table documents")
    return read_json(path), {
        "source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": source_id,
        "entry": deepcopy(entry), "path": path,
    }


def load_inputs(workspace, selection):
    """Read only the chosen complete native result family and its original identities."""
    _require(isinstance(selection, dict) and not set(selection) - {"source_collection_id", "analysis_source_id", "analysis_sha256", "title", "huc12s", "vintage"},
             "Select only the retained original analysis, title and HUC12 identifiers")
    collection = workspace._get("sources", identifier(selection.get("source_collection_id")))
    run_id = selection.get("analysis_source_id")
    _require(isinstance(run_id, str) and bool(run_id), "Select the original analysis-run source")
    run, original = _source(workspace, collection, run_id)
    _require(run.get("schema") == RUN_SCHEMA, "Choose the completed original Annual NLCD analysis-run document")
    expected = selection.get("analysis_sha256")
    if expected is not None:
        _require(expected == original["entry"]["body"]["sha256"], "The selected analysis source edition changed")
    transition_pair = run["rasters"]
    before_year, after_year = transition_pair["before"]["year"], transition_pair["after"]["year"]
    _require(isinstance(before_year, int) and isinstance(after_year, int) and before_year < after_year,
             "Original comparison needs two increasing annual product years")
    results = _indexed(run["results"], "path", "Original analysis results")
    names = [f"annual-{before_year}.json", f"annual-{after_year}.json",
             f"transitions-{before_year}-{after_year}.json"]
    documents, originals = [], [original]
    for name in names:
        declared = results.get(name)
        _require(isinstance(declared, dict), "Original analysis does not bind " + name)
        matches = [entry for entry in collection["entries"]
                   if entry["body"]["sha256"] == declared["sha256"]
                   and entry["body"]["bytes"] == declared["bytes"]]
        _require(len(matches) == 1, "Choose the unique retained original result for " + name)
        doc, source = _source(workspace, collection, matches[0]["id"])
        documents.append(doc)
        originals.append(source)
    before, after, transitions = documents
    _require(before.get("schema") == after.get("schema") == ANNUAL_SCHEMA
             and transitions.get("schema") == TRANSITION_SCHEMA, "Original land-cover result schemas differ")
    grid = run["grid"]
    _require(all(doc["grid"] == grid for doc in documents), "Completed annual results do not share one original grid")
    affine = grid["affine"]
    _require(len(affine) == 6 and all(isinstance(x, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(x) for x in affine),
             "Original grid needs its finite six-term affine transform")
    area = abs(affine[0] * affine[4] - affine[1] * affine[3])
    _require(area > 0, "Original native cells have no positive projected area")
    for doc in documents:
        _near(doc["method"]["cell_area_m2"], area, "Original method cell area")
        _require(doc["method"]["pixel_rule"] == transitions["method"]["pixel_rule"],
                 "Annual and transition results use different pixel attribution")
    _require(transitions["method"]["matrix_classes"] == list(CODES), "Original transition class ordering differs")
    domain_sha = run["source_domain_sha256"]
    _require(all(doc["metadata"]["domain_sha256"] == domain_sha for doc in documents),
             "Annual and transition results select different original reporting geometry")
    for side, annual in (("before", before), ("after", after)):
        raster = transition_pair[side]
        _require(transitions["metadata"][side] == raster and raster["epsg"] == 5070,
                 "Original transition raster bindings differ")
        _require(annual["metadata"]["year"] == raster["year"]
                 and annual["metadata"]["raster_sha256"] == raster["sha256"]
                 and annual["metadata"]["raster_bytes"] == raster["bytes"]
                 and annual["metadata"]["epsg"] == raster["epsg"]
                 and annual["metadata"]["nodata"] == raster["nodata"],
                 "Independent annual inventory binds a different original raster")
    a = _indexed(before["watersheds"], "huc12", "Original earlier watersheds")
    b = _indexed(after["watersheds"], "huc12", "Original later watersheds")
    paired = _indexed(transitions["watersheds"], "huc12", "Original paired watersheds")
    _require(set(a) == set(b) == set(paired) and paired, "Original watershed inventories differ")
    _require(transitions["domain"]["overlap_cells"] == before["domain"]["overlap_cells"]
             == after["domain"]["overlap_cells"] == 0,
             "Selected-HUC sums require the original analysis to have zero overlapping selected cells")
    matrices = {}
    for key, row in paired.items():
        _require(isinstance(key, str) and re.fullmatch(r"\d{12}", key), "Retain original twelve-character HUC12 identifiers")
        _require(row["properties"] == a[key]["properties"] == b[key]["properties"],
                 "Original watershed attributes differ between annual inventories")
        matrices[key] = _validate_row(row, a[key], b[key], area)
    for counter in SUPPORT:
        _require(sum(row[counter] for row in paired.values()) == transitions["domain"][counter],
                 "Original watershed support does not sum to the declared non-overlapping domain")
    domain_matrix = {(row["before_class"], row["after_class"]): row["cells"]
                     for row in transitions["domain"]["transitions"]}
    _require(len(transitions["domain"]["transitions"]) == 256 and
             set(domain_matrix) == {(x, y) for x in CODES for y in CODES},
             "Original domain directional matrix is incomplete")
    _require(all(sum(matrix[pair] for matrix in matrices.values()) == domain_matrix[pair]
                 for pair in domain_matrix), "Original watershed matrices differ from the domain union")
    binding = {
        "source_collection_id": collection["id"], "analysis_source_id": run_id,
        "analysis_sha256": original["entry"]["body"]["sha256"],
        "source_domain_sha256": domain_sha, "rasters": deepcopy(transition_pair),
        "inputs": [{"source_collection_id": item["source_collection_id"],
                    "source_id": item["source_id"], "entry": item["entry"]} for item in originals],
        "grid": deepcopy(grid), "coordinate_operation": deepcopy(run["coordinate_operation"]),
        "method": deepcopy(transitions["method"]), "original_huc_count": len(paired),
        "original_overlap_cells": 0,
    }
    return {"binding": binding, "originals": originals, "before": a, "after": b,
            "paired": paired, "matrices": matrices, "area": area}


def _aggregate(inputs, ids):
    paired = inputs["paired"]
    area_ha = inputs["area"] / 10000
    values = {key: sum(paired[huc][key] for huc in ids) for key in SUPPORT}
    matrix = {(x, y): sum(inputs["matrices"][huc][x, y] for huc in ids) for x in CODES for y in CODES}
    classes = []
    for code in CODES:
        before = sum(matrix[code, x] for x in CODES)
        after = sum(matrix[x, code] for x in CODES)
        stable = matrix[code, code]
        annual_before = sum(next(row["cells"] for row in inputs["before"][huc]["classes"]
                                 if row["class_code"] == code) for huc in ids)
        annual_after = sum(next(row["cells"] for row in inputs["after"][huc]["classes"]
                                if row["class_code"] == code) for huc in ids)
        counts = {"before_cells": before, "after_cells": after, "stable_cells": stable,
                  "gained_cells": after - stable, "lost_cells": before - stable, "net_cells": after - before,
                  "annual_before_cells": annual_before, "annual_after_cells": annual_after,
                  "before_only_cells": annual_before - before, "after_only_cells": annual_after - after}
        classes.append({"class_code": code, "label": CLASSES[code], **counts,
                        **{name[:-6] + "_ha": count * area_ha for name, count in counts.items()}})
    return {**values, "paired_valid_area_ha": values["paired_valid_cells"] * area_ha,
            "changed_area_ha": values["changed_class_cells"] * area_ha,
            "stable_area_ha": values["stable_class_cells"] * area_ha,
            "changed_percent_of_paired_valid": (100 * values["changed_class_cells"] / values["paired_valid_cells"]
                                               if values["paired_valid_cells"] else None),
            "classes": classes,
            "transitions": [{"before_class": x, "after_class": y, "cells": matrix[x, y],
                             "area_ha": matrix[x, y] * area_ha,
                             "percent_of_before_paired": (100 * matrix[x, y] / classes[CODES.index(x)]["before_cells"]
                                                          if classes[CODES.index(x)]["before_cells"] else None)}
                            for x in CODES for y in CODES]}


def summarize(inputs, selection):
    ids = selection.get("huc12s")
    _require(isinstance(ids, list) and ids and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in ids)
             and len(ids) == len(set(ids)) and set(ids) <= set(inputs["paired"]),
             "Select distinct original HUC12 identifiers from this analysis")
    title = selection.get("title") or "Selected watershed land-cover changes"
    _require(isinstance(title, str) and bool(title.strip()) and len(title.strip()) <= 240,
             "Name this selected watershed comparison in 240 characters or fewer")
    ids = sorted(ids)
    rows = [{"huc12": huc, "properties": deepcopy(inputs["paired"][huc]["properties"]),
             **_aggregate(inputs, [huc])} for huc in ids]
    return {"schema": SCHEMA, "edition": EDITION, "title": title.strip(),
            "selection": {"source_collection_id": inputs["binding"]["source_collection_id"],
                          "analysis_source_id": inputs["binding"]["analysis_source_id"],
                          "analysis_sha256": inputs["binding"]["analysis_sha256"], "huc12s": ids},
            "binding": deepcopy(inputs["binding"]), "classes": [{"code": c, "label": CLASSES[c]} for c in CODES],
            "class_label_source": CLASS_SOURCE, "interpretation": INTERPRETATION,
            "summary": _aggregate(inputs, ids), "watersheds": rows}

def _csv(columns, rows):
    stream = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(stream, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(columns)
    for row in rows:
        # Prefix formula-like string cells for spreadsheet opening; exact originals remain in JSON.
        writer.writerow([("'" + value) if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith(("=", "+", "-", "@"))
                         else value for value in row])
    return stream.getvalue().encode("utf-8")


def _display(value):
    """Format human tables only; scientific dictionaries and exports stay exact."""
    if value is None:
        return "Not available"
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if 0 < abs(value) < .0005:
            return "<0.001" if value > 0 else ">-0.001"
        return format(0.0 if value == 0 else value, ",.3f")
    if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        return format(value, ",d")
    return str(value)


def _table(columns, rows, *, widths=None, caption=None):
    value = {"kind": "table", "columns": columns,
             "rows": [[_display(item) for item in row] for row in rows]}
    if widths is not None:
        value["widths"] = widths
    if caption is not None:
        value["caption"] = caption
    return value

def _html(report, figure_product=None):
    def escaped(value):
        return html.escape("Not available" if value is None else str(value), quote=True)
    chunks = ['<!doctype html><html lang="en"><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">',
              "<title>" + escaped(report["title"]) + "</title>",
              "<style>body{font:16px system-ui;max-width:1200px;margin:32px auto;padding:0 24px;color:#202020;background:#fff}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}th,td{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:8px;text-align:right}th:first-child,td:first-child{text-align:left}section{margin:28px 0}.scroll{overflow:auto}.scroll:focus{outline:2px solid #333;outline-offset:3px}h1{font-size:28px}a{color:inherit;overflow-wrap:anywhere}li a{display:inline-block;min-height:28px;padding:8px 0}p{line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.identifier{white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}.label{text-align:left}figure{margin:24px 0}figure svg{display:block;width:100%;min-width:840px;height:auto}figcaption{line-height:1.5;margin:12px 0}caption{text-align:left;padding:8px 0}table th{font-weight:600}@media(max-width:700px){body{margin:16px auto;padding:0 12px}h1{font-size:24px}table{min-width:620px}}@media print{body{max-width:none;padding:0;margin:0;font-size:10pt}.scroll{overflow:visible}figure svg{min-width:0;width:100%;break-inside:avoid}thead{display:table-header-group}th,td{padding:4px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}table{min-width:0;font-size:8pt}h2,h3{break-after:avoid}}</style>",
              "<h1>" + escaped(report["title"]) + "</h1>",
              "<p>" + escaped(report["interpretation"]) + "</p>",
              "<p>Figures are embedded in this file. Extract selected-huc-landcover.zip to use every linked original data file.</p>"]
    def table(block):
        def cell(index, value):
            tag = "th" if index == 0 else "td"
            attrs = ' scope="row"' if index == 0 else ""
            if block["columns"][index] == "HUC12":
                attrs += ' class="identifier"'
            elif block["columns"][index] in ("Original name", "Description"):
                attrs += ' class="label"'
            return "<" + tag + attrs + ">" + escaped(value) + "</" + tag + ">"
        widths = block.get("widths")
        columns = ("<colgroup>" + "".join('<col style="width:' + str(100 * weight / sum(widths)) + '%">'
                                         for weight in widths) + "</colgroup>") if widths else ""
        return ('<div class="scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Original data table; scroll horizontally"><table>' +
                ("<caption>" + escaped(block["caption"]) + "</caption>" if block.get("caption") else "") +
                columns + "<thead><tr>" + "".join('<th scope="col">' + escaped(x) + "</th>" for x in block["columns"]) +
                "</tr></thead><tbody>" + "".join("<tr>" + "".join(
                    cell(index, value) for index, value in enumerate(row)) + "</tr>"
                    for row in block["rows"]) + "</tbody></table></div>")
    if figure_product:
        indexed = {row["id"]: row for row in figure_product["spec"]["figures"]}
        chunks.append("<section><h2>Selected watershed group figures</h2>")
        for choice in figure_product["figures"]:
            figure = indexed[choice["id"]]
            chunks.append("<figure><h3>" + escaped(figure["title"]) + "</h3>" +
                '<div class="scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Original group figure; scroll horizontally">' +
                '<div role="img" aria-label="' + escaped(figure["caption"]) + '">' +
                "<svg" + figure_product["svg"][choice["id"]].split("<svg", 1)[1] + "</div></div>" +
                "<figcaption>" + escaped(figure["caption"]) + "</figcaption></figure>")
            chunks.extend(table(block) for block in figure.get("detail_tables", []))
        chunks.append("</section>")
    for heading, blocks in report_sections(report):
        chunks.append("<section><h2>" + escaped(heading) + "</h2>")
        for block in blocks:
            if isinstance(block, str):
                chunks.append("<p>" + escaped(block) + "</p>")
            elif block["kind"] == "table":
                chunks.append(table(block))
            else:
                chunks.append("<ul>" + "".join('<li><a href="' + escaped(x["path"]) + '">' +
                              escaped(x["title"]) + "</a></li>" for x in block["items"]) + "</ul>")
        chunks.append("</section>")
    return ("\n".join(chunks) + "</html>\n").encode("utf-8")


def _write_outputs(directory, report, report_implementation, source_provenance_implementation):
    atomic_json(directory / "selection.json", report, immutable=True)
    atomic_json(directory / "original-inputs.json", report["binding"], immutable=True)
    figure_product = observed_landcover_report.prepare(directory, report, report_implementation)
    atomic_bytes(directory / "report.html", _html(report, figure_product), immutable=True)
    rows = report["watersheds"]
    atomic_bytes(directory / "huc-summary.csv", _csv(
        ["huc12", "name", "states", *SUPPORT, "paired_valid_area_ha", "changed_area_ha",
         "changed_percent_of_paired_valid", "original_properties_json"],
        [[row["huc12"], row["properties"].get("name", ""), row["properties"].get("states", ""),
          *[row[key] for key in SUPPORT], row["paired_valid_area_ha"], row["changed_area_ha"],
          row["changed_percent_of_paired_valid"], canonical(row["properties"]).decode("utf-8")] for row in rows]), immutable=True)

    transition_fields = list(report["summary"]["transitions"][0])
    atomic_bytes(directory / "huc-transitions.csv", _csv(["huc12", *transition_fields],
        [[row["huc12"], *[item[key] for key in transition_fields]] for row in rows for item in row["transitions"]]), immutable=True)
    atomic_bytes(directory / "selected-transitions.csv", _csv(transition_fields,
        [[item[key] for key in transition_fields] for item in report["summary"]["transitions"]]), immutable=True)
    files = {name: describe_file(directory, directory / name) for name in
            ("selection.json", "original-inputs.json", "report.html", "huc-summary.csv",
             "huc-classes.csv", "huc-transitions.csv", "selected-transitions.csv")}
    files.update(figure_product["files"])
    files.update(observed_landcover_provenance.retain(directory, report, source_provenance_implementation))
    return files, figure_product


def build(workspace, selection):
    inputs = load_inputs(workspace, selection)
    report = summarize(inputs, selection)
    report_implementation = observed_landcover_report.implementation()
    identity = {"edition": EDITION, "producer_sha256": file_digest(__file__),
                "report_implementation": report_implementation,
                "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "title": report["title"],
                "selection": report["selection"], "binding": report["binding"]}
    source_provenance_implementation = observed_landcover_provenance.implementation()
    # Add a separate identity key: do not change report_implementation passed to the group helper.
    identity["source_provenance_implementation"] = source_provenance_implementation
    key = digest(identity)
    report["source_provenance"] = observed_landcover_provenance.describe(
        report, workspace.project["id"], comparison_id=key)
    directory = workspace.root / KIND / key
    with held(directory / ".build.lock", blocking=False):
        if (directory / "receipt.json").exists():
            return inspect(workspace, key)["edition"]
        files, figure_product = _write_outputs(
            directory, report, report_implementation, source_provenance_implementation)
        for index, original in enumerate(inputs["originals"]):
            for body in [original["entry"]["body"], *original["entry"].get("companions", [])]:
                name = "originals/" + str(index) + "/" + _relative(body.get("view_path", body["filename"]))
                _require(name not in files, "Original input member paths collide")
                copied = copy_verified(workspace.root,
                    {"path": body["object"], "bytes": body["bytes"], "sha256": body["sha256"]},
                    directory, path=name)
                files[name] = describe_file(directory, directory / copied["path"])
        recipe = {"schema": observed_context.SCHEMA, "edition": EDITION, "title": report["title"],
                  "origin": {"kind": KIND, "id": key, "project_id": workspace.project["id"],
                             "huc12s": report["selection"]["huc12s"],
                             "area_method": "original_native_cell_centre"},
                  "inputs": [files[name] for name in sorted(files)],
                  "sections": report_sections(report),
                  "figure_spec": figure_product["figure_spec"], "figures": figure_product["figures"],
                  "source_links": sorted(name for name in files if name.startswith("originals/"))}
        atomic_json(directory / "observed-report.json", recipe, immutable=True)
        recipe_file = describe_file(directory, directory / "observed-report.json")
        source_id = "selected-huc-landcover-" + key
        years = report["binding"]["rasters"]
        manifest = {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": report["title"],
                    "scope": {"selected_huc12s": report["selection"]["huc12s"], "method": recipe["origin"]["area_method"]},
                    "entries": [{"id": source_id, "kind": "document", "role": observed_context.ROLE,
                                 "title": report["title"], "uri": "workspace://" + workspace.project["id"] + "/" + KIND + "/" + key,
                                 "vintage": "Original Annual NLCD " + str(years["before"]["year"]) + " to " + str(years["after"]["year"]),
                                 **recipe_file, "companions": [files[name] for name in sorted(files)],
                                 "metadata": {"origin": recipe["origin"], "source_kind": KIND}}]}
        atomic_json(directory / "sources.json", manifest, immutable=True)
        files["observed-report.json"] = recipe_file
        files["sources.json"] = describe_file(directory, directory / "sources.json")
        from .landcover_report_source import _write_bundle
        _write_bundle(directory, files, directory / "selected-huc-landcover.zip")
        files["selected-huc-landcover.zip"] = describe_file(directory, directory / "selected-huc-landcover.zip")
        collection = workspace.import_sources(directory / "sources.json")
        source = {"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": source_id}
        bound = observed_context.bind(workspace, {"source_roles": {observed_context.ROLE: source}})
        receipt = {"schema": SCHEMA, "id": key, "state": "complete", "title": report["title"],
                   "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "identity": identity,
                   "huc12s": report["selection"]["huc12s"], "summary": report["summary"],
                   "source": source, "observed_binding": bound,
                   "files": {name: describe_file(workspace.root, directory / item["path"]) for name, item in files.items()}}
        atomic_json(directory / "receipt.json", receipt, immutable=True)
        return receipt

def inspect(workspace, key):
    directory = workspace.root / KIND / identifier(key)
    receipt = _receipt(workspace, directory / "receipt.json")
    for item in receipt["files"].values():
        verify_file(workspace.root, item)
    report = read_json(verify_file(workspace.root, receipt["files"]["selection.json"]))
    _require(report["binding"] == receipt["identity"]["binding"]
             and report["selection"] == receipt["identity"]["selection"]
             and report["summary"] == receipt["summary"], "Saved selected report differs from its original identity")
    source_path, entry = workspace.source_file(receipt["source"]["source_collection_id"], receipt["source"]["source_id"])
    recipe_file = receipt["files"]["observed-report.json"]
    _require(entry.get("role") == observed_context.ROLE
             and entry["body"]["sha256"] == recipe_file["sha256"]
             and entry["body"]["bytes"] == recipe_file["bytes"], "Retained report recipe source differs")
    recipe = read_json(source_path)
    _require(recipe.get("origin", {}).get("id") == key
             and recipe.get("origin", {}).get("project_id") == workspace.project["id"],
             "Retained report recipe belongs to another original selection")
    expected_members = {name: row for name, row in receipt["files"].items()
                        if name not in ("observed-report.json", "sources.json", "selected-huc-landcover.zip")}
    actual_members = {body.get("view_path", body["filename"]): body for body in entry.get("companions", [])}
    _require(len(actual_members) == len(entry.get("companions", []))
             and set(actual_members) == set(expected_members)

## What the numbers mean

The original producer defines 16 Annual NLCD classes and retains every one of the 256 earlier-to-later class pairs for each HUC, including zero counts. The rows of a displayed matrix are the earlier year and the columns are the later year. The diagonal is unchanged class.

The reader preserves seven support quantities:

| Quantity | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Selected native cells | Every original pixel selected by the source watershed rule |
| Paired-valid cells | Cells with supported original classes in both years |
| Earlier-only valid | Earlier-year class is available, later-year value is NoData |
| Later-only valid | Later-year class is available, earlier-year value is NoData |
| Both NoData | Neither year has a supported class |
| Stable class cells | Paired cells whose class is identical in both years |
| Changed class cells | Paired cells whose class differs between the two years |

The first four validity categories partition selected support:

    paired-valid + earlier-only + later-only + both-NoData = selected cells

Stable plus changed cells equals paired-valid cells. Changed percentage is changed cells divided by paired-valid cells. A selection with zero paired-valid cells has an unavailable percentage, with its zero denominator shown explicitly.

Class gains are off-diagonal transitions into a class; losses are off-diagonal transitions out of it. Net is later minus earlier on paired support, and equals gains minus losses. The desk also retains independent annual class counts, areas and unmatched valid counts. It does not silently substitute paired margins for an annual inventory.

The hectare conversion uses the absolute determinant of the original native affine transform, divided by 10,000. Both original rasters are bound to EPSG:5070. The exact transform and declared cell area remain in the report, and stored source area values must agree with their cell counts. The source analysis uses **centre inclusion; half-open scanline edges; even-odd ring parity**. It reports zero overlapping selected cells. The reader requires that condition before summing selected HUCs, then checks all original HUC counts and directional matrices against the source domain union. Union percentages are computed after summing counts; they are not averages of watershed percentages.

A changed annual product classification alone does not establish the physical cause, the date of a change within the interval, or classification accuracy. These class observations do not estimate pollutant export. Original whole-HUC reporting attributes and class support remain attached.

Class names follow the official USGS Annual NLCD legend: https://pubs.usgs.gov/fs/2025/3001/fs20253001.pdf . Original result documents retain their producer metadata, raster SHA-256 identities, declared product years, NoData codes, source-domain hash and coordinate operation.

def _package_members(archive_path, directory, receipt):
    """Verify and extract every declared original member with bounded memory."""
    import hashlib
    import stat
    import zipfile
    from pathlib import PurePosixPath
    from model.common import file_digest

    expected = {**receipt["members"],
                "Package_Manifest.json": receipt["files"]["Package_Manifest.json"]}
    directory = Path(directory)
    required(not directory.is_symlink(), "Keep the recipient package in an ordinary receiving directory")
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    root = directory.resolve(strict=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        required(len(names) == len(set(names)) and set(names) == set(expected),
                 "The recipient ZIP inventory differs from every declared original member")
        for name, descriptor in sorted(expected.items()):
            part = PurePosixPath(name)
            required(bool(name) and not part.is_absolute() and str(part) == name
                     and ".." not in part.parts and "\\" not in name
                     and all(ord(char) >= 32 for char in name),
                     "The recipient ZIP contains an invalid original member path")
            info = archive.getinfo(name)
            mode = info.external_attr >> 16
            required(not info.is_dir() and stat.S_IFMT(mode) in (0, stat.S_IFREG)
                     and info.file_size == descriptor["bytes"],
                     "The recipient ZIP member kind or length differs: " + name)
            target = root.joinpath(*part.parts)
            for parent in (target, *target.parents):
                if parent == root:
                    break
                required(not parent.is_symlink(), "The recipient destination contains a file alias")
            required(target.resolve().is_relative_to(root),
                     "Keep each recipient member in its original receiving folder")
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            pending = target.with_name("." + target.name + ".receiving")
            required(not pending.is_symlink(), "The recipient staging member is an alias")
            checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
            try:
                with archive.open(info) as source, pending.open("wb") as output:
                    while chunk := source.read(1024 * 1024):
                        count += len(chunk)
                        required(count <= descriptor["bytes"], "Recipient member exceeds its declared length")
                        checksum.update(chunk)
                        output.write(chunk)
                    output.flush()
                    os.fsync(output.fileno())
                required(count == descriptor["bytes"] and checksum.hexdigest() == descriptor["sha256"],
                         "Recipient member differs from its original descriptor: " + name)
                if target.exists():
                    required(target.is_file() and target.stat().st_size == count
                             and file_digest(target) == checksum.hexdigest(),
                             "An already received original member differs: " + name)
                else:
                    os.link(pending, target)
            finally:
                pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    manifest = read_json(root / "Package_Manifest.json")
    required(manifest.get("schema") == receipt["schema"]
             and manifest.get("id") == receipt["id"]
             and manifest.get("identity") == receipt["identity"]
             and manifest.get("study") == receipt["study"]
             and manifest.get("members") == receipt["members"]
             and manifest.get("ordered_report_sources") == receipt["ordered_report_sources"],
             "The extracted recipient manifest changed its retained selection or source order")
    return {"directory": str(root), "members": len(expected),
            "bytes": sum(item["bytes"] for item in expected.values()),
            "manifest": describe_file(root, root / "Package_Manifest.json")}

def required(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def download(operator, ticket, destination=None):
    """Consume the actual original native ticket and independently hash its stream."""
    stream, item = operator.open_download(ticket["id"])
    checksum, count = hashlib.sha256(), 0
    pending = Path(str(destination) + ".partial") if destination else None
    target = None
    try:
        if pending:
            pending.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target = pending.open("wb")
        while block := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
            checksum.update(block)
            count += len(block)
            if target:
                target.write(block)
    finally:
        stream.close()
        if target:
            target.close()
    required(count == ticket["bytes"] == item["bytes"] and
             checksum.hexdigest() == ticket["sha256"] == item["sha256"],
             "Original native download differs from its retained ticket")
    if destination:
        destination = Path(destination)
        if destination.exists():
            required(destination.stat().st_size == count and file_digest(destination) == checksum.hexdigest(),
                     "Previously received output differs from the same native download")
            pending.unlink()
        else:
            pending.replace(destination)
    return {"filename": item["filename"], "bytes": count, "sha256": checksum.hexdigest(),
            **({"path": str(Path(destination).resolve())} if destination else {})}

class Course:
    def __init__(self, path, configuration):
        self.path = path
        self.value = read_json(path) if path.exists() else {
            "schema": SCHEMA, "configuration": configuration, "phases": {}, "complete": False}
        required(self.value.get("schema") == SCHEMA and self.value.get("configuration") == configuration,
                 "Resume this original receiving course with its saved configuration")
        self.write()

    def write(self):
        atomic_json(self.path, self.value)

    def task(self, operator, workspace, phase, action, payload, *, timeout, resume_failed=False):
        frozen = json.loads(canonical(payload))
        wanted = {"workspace": workspace, "action": action, "payload": frozen}
        request = digest(wanted)
        original = self.value["phases"].get(phase)
        if original:
            required(original["request_sha256"] == request,
                     "A saved receiving phase has another original selection: " + phase)
        else:
            original = {"request_sha256": request, "request": wanted,
                        "operation_id": "huc-" + digest({"operation": self.value["configuration"]["operation_id"],
                                                      "phase": phase})[:56]}
            self.value["phases"][phase] = original
            self.write()
        if original.get("task_id"):
            task = operator.task(original["task_id"])
        else:
            task = operator.submit(workspace, action, frozen, original["operation_id"])
            # The native queue may coalesce an identical active request owned by
            # another operation. Preserve the actual accepted identity before waiting.
            original["task_id"] = task["id"]
            original["accepted_operation_id"] = task["operation_id"]
            self.write()
        required(task["workspace"] == workspace and task["action"] == action
                 and task["payload"] == frozen, "The original queue returned another receiving selection")
        if task["state"] == "interrupted" or (resume_failed and task["state"] in ("failed", "cancelled")):
            task = operator.resume(task["id"])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
        while task["state"] in ("queued", "running"):
            original["state"] = task["state"]
            self.write()
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                raise TimeoutError("The original task remains " + task["state"] + ": " + task["id"])
            time.sleep(0.5)
            task = operator.task(task["id"])
        original["state"] = task["state"]
        if task["state"] != "complete":
            original["error"] = task.get("error")
            self.write()
            raise RuntimeError("Original " + phase + " task ended " + task["state"] + ": " + json.dumps(task.get("error")))
        if "result" in original:
            required(original["result"] == task["result"],
                     "The saved complete native result changed: " + phase)
        original["result"] = task["result"]
        original.pop("error", None)
        self.write()
        return task

    def application(self, current, *, reviewed_revision=None, resume_failed=False):
        """Retain explicit implementation repairs without changing scientific selection."""
        prior = self.value.get("application_files")
        history = self.value.setdefault("application_revisions", [])
        if prior is not None and not history:
            history.append({"revision": self.value["configuration"]["source_revision"],
                            "files": prior, "application_sha256": digest(prior), "kind": "original"})
        if prior is None:
            history.append({"revision": self.value["configuration"]["source_revision"],
                            "files": current, "application_sha256": digest(current),
                            "kind": "original"})
        elif prior != current:
            required(not self.value.get("complete") and resume_failed
                     and isinstance(reviewed_revision, str) and reviewed_revision.strip(),
                     "Resume the incomplete original course with --resume-failed and "
                     "--reviewed-source-revision naming the repaired source edition")
            revision = reviewed_revision.strip()
            required(not any(row["revision"] == revision and row["files"] != current for row in history),
                     "This reviewed source revision already identifies another implementation")
            history.append({"revision": revision, "files": current,
                            "application_sha256": digest(current), "kind": "implementation-repair",
                            "previous_application_sha256": digest(prior),
                            "retained_phases": {phase: {key: row.get(key) for key in
                                ("task_id", "operation_id", "accepted_operation_id", "state", "request_sha256")}
                                for phase, row in self.value["phases"].items()}})
        elif reviewed_revision:
            required(any(row["revision"] == reviewed_revision.strip() and row["files"] == current
                         for row in history),
                     "The reviewed revision must name the actual recorded implementation repair")
        self.value["application_files"] = current
        self.write()

    def report_payload(self, operator, workspace, payload, prepared, *, reviewed_revision=None):
        """Use the original request, or explicitly supersede an incomplete old preview."""
        phase = "scientific-report"
        original = self.value["phases"].get(phase)
        if not original:
            return {**payload, "preview_id": prepared["id"]}
        saved = original["request"]
        required(saved["workspace"] == workspace and saved["action"] == "source-reports.render"
                 and {key: value for key, value in saved["payload"].items() if key != "preview_id"} == payload,
                 "The original scientific report phase has another source selection or title")
        if saved["payload"]["preview_id"] == prepared["id"]:
            return saved["payload"]
        if original.get("task_id"):
            task = operator.task(original["task_id"])
        else:
            # Reconcile a lost original admission before considering another preview.
            task = operator.submit(workspace, saved["action"], saved["payload"], original["operation_id"])
            original.update(task_id=task["id"], accepted_operation_id=task["operation_id"])
            self.write()
        required(task["workspace"] == workspace and task["action"] == saved["action"]
                 and task["payload"] == saved["payload"], "The original report task selection changed")
        output = scientific_report_editions.directory(operator.ws(workspace), saved["payload"]["preview_id"])
        if task["state"] in ("complete", "queued", "running") or (output / "operation.json").is_file():
            # Completed native effects are reconciled by the original report renderer.
            return saved["payload"]
        required(task["state"] in ("failed", "interrupted", "cancelled"),
                 "Resolve the original native report task before reviewing its successor")
        history = self.value.get("application_revisions", [])
        required(reviewed_revision and history and history[-1]["kind"] == "implementation-repair"
                 and history[-1]["revision"] == reviewed_revision.strip()
                 and history[-1]["files"] == self.value["application_files"],
                 "The renderer changed before completing this report; resume with its recorded "
                 "--reviewed-source-revision and --resume-failed")
        # The source/title/contact are unchanged. The renderer's new preview is the
        # authority for a new report identity; the prior request/task remain intact.
        old = {**original, "state": task["state"], "error": task.get("error")}
        predecessors = list(old.pop("predecessors", []))
        predecessors.append(old)
        replacement = {**payload, "preview_id": prepared["id"]}
        wanted = {"workspace": workspace, "action": saved["action"], "payload": replacement}
        operation_id = "huc-" + digest({
            "operation": self.value["configuration"]["operation_id"], "phase": phase,
            "reviewed_preview_id": prepared["id"], "source_revision": reviewed_revision.strip()})[:56]
        self.value["phases"][phase] = {
            "request_sha256": digest(wanted), "request": wanted, "operation_id": operation_id,
            "predecessors": predecessors, "repair": {
                "source_revision": reviewed_revision.strip(), "previous_preview_id": saved["payload"]["preview_id"],
                "reviewed_preview_id": prepared["id"], "previous_task_id": task["id"],
                "scientific_sources": payload["sources"], "title": payload["title"]}}
        self.write()
        return replacement


def original_source_intake(args, course):
    """Bind explicit existing sources without changing the original course configuration."""
    manifest = getattr(args, "source_manifest", None)
    collection_id = getattr(args, "source_collection_id", None)
    analysis_id = getattr(args, "analysis_source_id", None)
    saved = course.value.get("original_source_intake")
    if saved:
        required(isinstance(saved, dict) and isinstance(saved.get("request"), dict),
                 "The original source-intake record is incomplete")
    requested = None
    if manifest:
        phase = course.value["phases"].get("original-source-import")
        if saved and phase:
            # The phase journals its exact native preview before admission. Reconcile
            # that original task even when its temporary staging has been removed;
            # unfinished workers still validate the original preview's source bytes.
            required(phase["request"]["action"] == "source.import",
                     "The retained source-intake phase uses another original action")
            original = saved["request"].get("manifest")
            required(saved["request"].get("mode") == "registered-manifest"
                     and isinstance(original, dict),
                     "Resume with the same original source-intake choice")
            requested = {"mode": "registered-manifest", "manifest": {
                "path": str(manifest.resolve()), "bytes": original["bytes"],
                "sha256": original["sha256"]}}
        else:
            manifest = manifest.resolve(strict=True)
            required(manifest.is_file(), "Choose the original source manifest file")
            requested = {"mode": "registered-manifest", "manifest": {
                "path": str(manifest), "bytes": manifest.stat().st_size, "sha256": file_digest(manifest)}}
    elif collection_id:
        requested = {"mode": "existing-collection", "source_collection_id": collection_id}
    if requested is not None and analysis_id:
        requested["analysis_source_id"] = analysis_id
    if saved:
        if requested is not None:
            required(saved["request"] == requested, "Resume with the same original source-intake choice")
        return saved["request"]
    if requested is not None:
        required(not course.value["phases"].get("original-source-import")
                 and not course.value["phases"].get("selected-comparison")
                 and not course.value.get("native_products"),
                 "Keep the original accepted import/selection; explicit intake must precede its admission")
        course.value["original_source_intake"] = {"request": requested}
        course.write()
    return requested


def registered_manifests(intake, course):
    """Register a new intake only; retained native tasks reconcile their original preview."""
    if not intake or intake["mode"] != "registered-manifest":
        return ()
    phase = course.value["phases"].get("original-source-import")
    if phase:
        required(phase["request"]["action"] == "source.import",
                 "The retained source-intake phase uses another original action")
        # Its immutable preview already retains path/hash. Reconcile the actual task before
        # requiring temporary files; unfinished workers still validate the original preview.
        return ()
    original = intake["manifest"]
    path = Path(original["path"]).resolve(strict=True)
    required(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size == original["bytes"]
             and file_digest(path) == original["sha256"],
             "The original staged source manifest changed before its import completed")
    return (path,)


def select_original_source(operator, workspace_key, intake, course, task):
    if intake is None:
        return task("original-source-import", "observed.landcover.import", {})["result"]
    if intake["mode"] == "registered-manifest":
        prior = course.value["phases"].get("original-source-import")
        if prior:
            required(prior["request"]["action"] == "source.import",
                     "The retained source-intake phase uses another original action")
            payload = prior["request"]["payload"]
        else:
            original = intake["manifest"]
            matches = [item for item in operator.registered.values()
                       if item["path"] == original["path"] and item["sha256"] == original["sha256"]]
            required(len(matches) == 1, "Register the exact original staged manifest before import")
            preview = operator.preview_source({"registered_id": matches[0]["id"]})
            payload = {"preview_id": preview["id"]}
        collection = task("original-source-import", "source.import", payload)["result"]
        collection_id = collection["id"]
    else:
        required(intake["mode"] == "existing-collection", "Unknown original source-intake mode")
        collection_id = intake["source_collection_id"]
    candidates = [row for row in observed_landcover.catalog(operator.ws(workspace_key))["sources"]
                  if row["source_collection_id"] == collection_id
                  and (not intake.get("analysis_source_id")
                       or row["analysis_source_id"] == intake["analysis_source_id"])]
    required(len(candidates) == 1,
             "Choose the unique original analysis-run source in the exact imported collection; "
             "use --analysis-source-id when that collection contains several analyses")
    choice = {name: candidates[0][name] for name in
              ("source_collection_id", "analysis_source_id", "analysis_sha256")}
    saved = course.value["original_source_intake"].get("selection")
    required(saved is None or saved == choice, "The retained original source-intake identity changed")
    return choice


def cold_reopen(args):
    required(args.selection_id and args.report_id and args.expected_project_id,
             "Cold reopening needs the actual saved selection, report and project identities")
    operator = Operator(args.workspace, args.state_directory)
    try:
        required(operator.ws(operator.primary).project["id"] == args.expected_project_id,
                 "The restored application opened another project")
        operator.extensions.verify_workspace(operator.ws(operator.primary))
        result = check_products(operator, operator.primary, args.selection_id, args.report_id)
        result["application"] = str(APPLICATION.resolve())
        result["application_model_sha256"] = file_digest(APPLICATION / "model/observed_landcover.py")
        atomic_json(args.output / "cold-reopen.json", result)
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    finally:
        operator.close()


def run(args):
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.cold_reopen:
        return cold_reopen(args)
    if args.recipient_handover:
        from source_tools.receive_observed_landcover_study import run_recipient_handover
        return run_recipient_handover(args)
    if args.selected_study:
        from source_tools.receive_observed_landcover_study import run_selected_study
        return run_selected_study(args)
    configuration = {
        "operation_id": args.operation_id, "application": str(APPLICATION.resolve()),
        "workspace": str(args.workspace.resolve()), "state_directory": str(args.state_directory.resolve()),
        "huc12s": sorted(args.huc12 or DEFAULT_HUCS), "title": args.title,
        "source_revision": args.source_revision,
    }
    required(len(configuration["huc12s"]) == len(set(configuration["huc12s"])), "Select each original HUC once")
    course = Course(args.output / "selected-huc-receiving.json", configuration)
    intake = original_source_intake(args, course)
    app_members = ("model/observed_landcover.py", "model/observed_landcover_report.py",
                   "model/observed_landcover_provenance.py", "CURRENT_OWNER_DIRECTION.md", "AGENTS.md",
                   "operator/observed_landcover_operator.py",
                   "operator/extensions/observed-landcover.json", "operator/web/observed_landcover.mjs",
                   "operator/source_report_editions.py", "model/scientific_report_editions.py",
                   "model/observed_report_render.py", "model/observed_context.py",
                   "model/scientific_report.py", "model/scientific_figures.py",
                   "model/landcover_report_source.py", "model/reuse.py", "model/workspace.py",
                   "operator/server.py", "operator/extension_registry.py",
                   "source_tools/receive_observed_landcover.py")
    if intake is None:
        app_members += ("observations/landcover_2023_2025/model-sources.json",)
    current_application = {name: describe_file(APPLICATION, APPLICATION / name) for name in app_members}
    for name in ("model/scientific_map_figures.py",):
        if (APPLICATION / name).is_file():
            current_application[name] = describe_file(APPLICATION, APPLICATION / name)
    course.application(current_application, reviewed_revision=args.reviewed_source_revision,
                       resume_failed=args.resume_failed)
    operator = None
    try:
        operator = Operator(args.workspace, args.state_directory, create=args.create, title=args.title,
                            restore_directory=args.restore_directory,
                            source_manifests=registered_manifests(intake, course))
        key = operator.primary
        project = operator.ws(key).project["id"]
        required(course.value.get("project_id", project) == project, "The original receiving project changed")
        course.value.update(project_id=project, original_workspace_key=key)
        course.write()
        actions = ("observed.landcover.save", "source-reports.render", "source-reports.export")
        if intake is None:
            actions += ("observed.landcover.import",)
        for action in actions:
            required(operator.extensions.handles_action(action), "The current original operator has not registered " + action)
        def task(phase, action, payload):
            return course.task(operator, key, phase, action, payload, timeout=args.timeout_seconds,
                               resume_failed=args.resume_failed)
        imported = select_original_source(operator, key, intake, course, task)
        inputs = operator.extensions.read("POST", "/api/observed-landcover/inputs", key, {"selection": imported})
        if intake is not None:
            # The maintained reader verifies every original result, grid, domain and matrix before publication.
            course.value["original_source_intake"]["selection"] = imported
            course.write()
        available = {row["huc12"] for row in inputs["watersheds"]}
        required(set(configuration["huc12s"]) <= available, "Selected HUCs are absent from the actual native original inventory")
        selection = {**imported, "huc12s": configuration["huc12s"], "title": args.title}
        selected_task = task("selected-comparison", "observed.landcover.save", selection)
        edition = selected_task["result"]
        selected = observed_landcover.inspect(operator.ws(key), edition["id"])
        required(selected["report"]["selection"]["huc12s"] == configuration["huc12s"],
                 "The completed original comparison differs from the receiving selection")
        source_payload = {"sources": [edition["source"]], "title": args.title}
        report_adapter = ScientificReportEditions(operator, Fault)
        prepared = report_adapter.preview(key, source_payload)
        source_payload = course.report_payload(operator, key, source_payload, prepared,
                                               reviewed_revision=args.reviewed_source_revision
                                               if args.resume_failed else None)
        report_task = task("scientific-report", "source-reports.render", source_payload)
        report_id = report_task["result"]["scientific_report_edition_id"]
        exported_task = task("scientific-report-export", "source-reports.export", {"id": report_id})
        current_products = check_products(operator, key, edition["id"], report_id)
        prior_products = course.value.get("native_products")
        if prior_products:
            for name in ("project_id", "selection_id", "scientific_report_edition_id", "huc12s",
                         "source", "source_binding", "summary", "report_file_hashes", "selection_file_hashes"):
                required(prior_products[name] == current_products[name],
                         "A completed original scientific product changed during recovery: " + name)
        course.value["native_products"] = current_products
        products = operator.task_view(selected_task["id"])["_downloads"]
        selected_zip = next(row for row in products if row["filename"] == "selected-huc-landcover.zip")
        course.value["comparison_download"] = download(operator, selected_zip, args.output / "selected-huc-landcover.zip")
        course.value["report_download"] = download(operator, exported_task["result"]["download"],
                                                  args.output / "selected-huc-scientific-report.zip")
        report_detail = report_adapter.detail(key, report_id)
        pdf_ticket = next(row for row in report_detail["_downloads"] if row["filename"] == "report.pdf")
        course.value["pdf_download"] = download(operator, pdf_ticket, args.output / "selected-huc-scientific-report.pdf")
        course.write()
        backup_task = task("workspace-backup", "workspace.backup", {"include_intermediates": False})
        backup_result = backup_task["result"]
        archive_path = Path(backup_result["path"])
        backup_ticket = operator.task_view(backup_task["id"])["_downloads"][0]
        course.value["backup_download"] = download(operator, backup_ticket)
        original_manifest = portable.inspect_archive(archive_path, verify=True)
        required(original_manifest["project"]["id"] == project, "Native Workspace archive has another project identity")
        # Receive the actual native ticket stream through the existing upload CAS.
        archive_stream, archive_item = operator.open_download(backup_ticket["id"])
        try:
            upload = operator.receive_upload(archive_stream, archive_item["bytes"], archive_item["filename"], "application/zip")
        finally:
            archive_stream.close()
        required(upload["sha256"] == backup_result["sha256"], "Received native archive differs from the original backup")
        received_task = task("workspace-restore", "workspace.restore", {"upload_id": upload["id"]})
        received = received_task["result"]
        required(received["identity"] == "MATCH" and received["project"]["id"] == project,
                 "Original Workspace restoration did not preserve project identity")
        restored_key = received["workspace_key"]
        restored = check_products(operator, restored_key, edition["id"], report_id)
        for name in ("huc12s", "source", "source_binding", "summary", "report_file_hashes", "selection_file_hashes"):
            required(restored[name] == course.value["native_products"][name], "Restored original product differs: " + name)
        course.value["restore"] = {"result": received, "products": restored, "upload": upload}
        course.write()
        operator.close()
        operator = None
        # Original task registry and restored Workspace must survive an operator restart.
        operator = Operator(args.workspace, args.state_directory, restore_directory=args.restore_directory)
        restarted = check_products(operator, restored_key, edition["id"], report_id)
        required(restarted["selection_file_hashes"] == restored["selection_file_hashes"]
                 and restarted["report_file_hashes"] == restored["report_file_hashes"],
                 "Restarted native files differ")
        for phase in course.value["phases"].values():
            saved = operator.task_view(phase["task_id"])
            required(saved["state"] == "complete" and saved["payload"] == phase["request"]["payload"],
                     "The original completed queue operation did not reopen")
        for phase in course.value["phases"].values():
            for prior in phase.get("predecessors", []):
                saved = operator.task(prior["task_id"])
                required(saved["workspace"] == prior["request"]["workspace"]
                         and saved["action"] == prior["request"]["action"]
                         and saved["payload"] == prior["request"]["payload"]
                         and saved["operation_id"] == prior["accepted_operation_id"],
                         "The earlier reviewed report attempt did not retain its original native request")
        course.value["restart"] = restarted
        course.write()
        operator.close()
        operator = None
        restored_application = Path(received["application"]).resolve(strict=True)
        restored_driver = restored_application / "source_tools/receive_observed_landcover.py"
        required(restored_driver.is_file(), "The complete restored application did not retain this native receiver")
        cold_output = args.output / "cold"
        cold_output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        command = [sys.executable, str(restored_driver), "--workspace", received["workspace"],
                   "--state-directory", str(args.output / "cold-operator-state"), "--output", str(cold_output),
                   "--cold-reopen", "--selection-id", edition["id"], "--report-id", report_id,
                   "--expected-project-id", project]
        course.value["cold_command"] = command
        course.write()
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=restored_application, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                timeout=args.timeout_seconds, check=False)
        (args.output / "cold-stdout.json").write_text(result.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
        (args.output / "cold-stderr.txt").write_text(result.stderr, encoding="utf-8")
        required(result.returncode == 0, "The actual restored application failed cold reopening: " + result.stderr[-4000:])
        cold = read_json(cold_output / "cold-reopen.json")
        required(cold["application"] == str(restored_application)
                 and cold["selection_file_hashes"] == restored["selection_file_hashes"]
                 and cold["report_file_hashes"] == restored["report_file_hashes"]
                 and cold["application_model_sha256"] == current_application["model/observed_landcover.py"]["sha256"],
                 "Actual restored application/product identities differ")
        course.value.update(cold_reopen=cold, complete=True)
        course.value.pop("error", None)
        course.write()
        print(json.dumps(course.value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    except Exception as error:
        course.value.update(complete=False, error={"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
        course.write()
        raise
    finally:
        if operator is not None:
            operator.close()


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--state-directory", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--restore-directory", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--create", action="store_true", help="Create this receiving Workspace if it does not yet exist")
    parser.add_argument("--operation-id", default="ECO-264B-SELECTED-HUC-20261013")
    parser.add_argument("--source-revision", default="installed-current-application")
    source = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    source.add_argument("--source-manifest", type=Path,
                        help="Register and queue-import an already staged original source manifest")
    source.add_argument("--source-collection-id",
                        help="Use this existing original source collection in the receiving Workspace")
    parser.add_argument("--analysis-source-id",
                        help="Exact analysis-run source ID when the chosen manifest/collection has several analyses")
    parser.add_argument("--huc12", action="append", help="Actual original HUC12; repeat for selected watersheds")
    parser.add_argument("--title", default="Selected Upper Savannah watershed annual land-cover changes")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout-seconds", type=float, default=1800)
    parser.add_argument("--resume-failed", action="store_true", help="Resume the saved course after repairing its failed phase")
    parser.add_argument("--reviewed-source-revision",
                        help="Reviewed repaired implementation revision; keeps original selection, task and product history")
    parser.add_argument("--recipient-handover", action="store_true",
                        help="Receive the complete recipient package for the completed original comparison/report")
    parser.add_argument("--selected-study", action="store_true",
                        help="Continue the completed original selection/report through editable selected-Study receiving")
    parser.add_argument("--cold-reopen", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--selection-id", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--report-id", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-project-id", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    required(not (args.recipient_handover and (args.selected_study or args.cold_reopen)),
             "Choose one original receiving continuation at a time")
    required(not args.analysis_source_id or args.source_manifest or args.source_collection_id,
             "--analysis-source-id requires an explicit original source manifest or collection")
    required(not (args.source_manifest or args.source_collection_id) or not (
        args.selected_study or args.recipient_handover or args.cold_reopen),
        "The completed Study/handover/reopen continuations retain their original source; "
        "use explicit intake only for the initial comparison/report course")
    required(args.timeout_seconds > 0, "Use a positive original task timeout")
    return run(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}}), file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
